opinions.text: The admin log tables (Action, Legacy, Error, Request, Bug Reports, Jobs, Workers) all set cell text in text-sm through LOG_TEXT; one change to Admin::LogStylesHelper::LOG_TEXT would fix every TYPE-03 row in this group at once.
Mode buttons on Action Logs and Request Log (filled primary = current view) work as tabs; tab_navigation or a documented segmented control would settle both TABS-01 and BTN-05.
documents/body.html.erb prints stored HTML with html_safe; besides FORM-09, the rich_text helper presumably also sanitizes, so the swap is worth checking for safety, not only looks.
enrollment_roster marks a missing account with red bold "* unknown *" while every sibling admin page uses a warning ui_badge for the same kind of state.
Job state "In Progress" uses a :warning badge for a normal running state; warning colour reads as trouble.
rbs_alerts/_group.html.erb:30 calls edit_link without an aria label, so every row's button is just "Edit"; sibling tables name the record in aria-label.
Count lines vary across admin lists: ui_section title, div.text-lg, p.text-base, filter_bar count:, strong notice. A documented count-line pattern would settle them.
Empty-value placeholders in admin mix "-", "—", "— none —", blank cells and fact words; value_or_dash is available and prints "—".
settings/index description "Adjust system settings" has no full stop, and settings/edit back link reads "Settings Listing" while the page title is "System Settings".
The mailbox folder row and the survey report switcher are two more hand-made tab rows; tab_navigation may need a link-tab mode (Turbo stream links, aria-current) so these can use it.
button_to built from button_classes recurs for Turbo-safe one-button forms (mailbox toggles, Select recipient); a ButtonHelper method for a one-button form would retire it.
Several partials have no callers (_form_wrapper, _error_summary, _preferred_name_disclaimer, _turbo_partial_wrapper) and could be deleted.
The mailbox's review-pane rows are three lines; Pattern 7 says one line per record. Either the guide should list the mailbox as a variant or the rule should be scoped to the intake pages.
Several aria-labels replace their visible text ("Select <callsign>" vs "Select Ranger", "Mark as unread" vs "Mark Unread"), which fails WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name; no guide rule names it.
The overlapping-shift badge differs between siblings: lowercase :error with no icon on the schedule row, "Overlapping shift" :warning with an icon on the slot card.
The Show/Hide Sign-Ups toggle swaps in a minus icon on available sign-up cards but a plain "Hide Sign-Ups" on schedule rows.
available_sign_ups/show's Upcoming Shifts title prints stray spaces from ERB whitespace ("(3 shifts , 2 sign-ups )").
schedule/index's phone button reads "Available Sign-Up" (singular) while the desktop box says "Available Sign-Ups".
Work history pages format credits with "%.2f" while the timesheet and schedule pages use credit_format.
signup_summary's three stat boxes match the guide's own ui_stat_row example word for word but are not wrapped in ui_stat_row.
schedule/index and timesheet/index share the same two-column md/rail layout with gap-6 vs gap-4; a shared helper or partial would stop the drift.
timesheet/edit text-area labels are sentences ending in a colon ("Enter your brief explanation below:") rather than short field names.
alerts/edit.html.erb has no hero description, unlike every other page in scope; the admin field label "SMS Phone " (52) has a trailing space.
person_banners/_banner.html.erb:30-34 says the message keeps its line breaks, but the div has no whitespace-pre-line, so stored newlines likely collapse; needs a rendered check.
announcements/_announcement.html.erb:6 dims expired cards with opacity-70 over all text, which may push muted metadata below AA contrast; needs a rendered contrast check in both themes.
Hero back_to labels are sentence case where sibling buttons are Title Case: rbs_history/show "Broadcast history" (9) and rbs_history/retried "This broadcast" (12).
rbs_messages/index draws ui_pager twice, and the second shows under the empty state; and its toggle column has a blank "" heading that screen readers announce as an unnamed column.

Five hand-made bordered message/text boxes (announcement, survey prologue/epilogue, broadcast review, broadcast record, message detail row) with differing max heights suggest a shared helper is missing.
rbs/index.html.erb:15 quotes "Any time" while the section it names is titled "Any Time".
Stat-box variant switching by count (warning/error when positive, else secondary/success) repeats across six pages with no documented rule for when a zero is green versus neutral.
The guide's radius table (588) puts buttons and inputs at 12px, but daisyUI draws them at --radius-field 8px; either the table or the token should move, since the two disagree on every page.

Status tints have four alpha ladders (box /5 /20, vc-progress /10 /30, review-line /10, login /10 /26) against one documented pair (bg-x/10, border-x/30); one callout tint scale would make the semantic colours read the same everywhere.

Frozen first column and bounded 70vh scroll pane are each written four or three times (roster-matrix, hours-credits, top-hour-earners, shift-coverage, sandman-qualified) with different z-index and breakpoint choices; a shared matrix-table component would settle them.

The five print sheets restate one paper-preview skeleton (8.5in, masthead rule, doc label, zebra rows) in hex and pt; a shared print-sheet base file and a documented print section in the guide would replace five copies.

The login door makes amber its brand colour (frame, wash, backdrop, links, submit gradient, focus, caret), which contradicts the guide's statement that Signal Blue is the only chromatic chrome colour; if the door is a sanctioned exception the guide should say so beside 180-188.

The guide contradicts itself on section titles: heading-section is font-semibold (533) while the Typography Quick Reference says font-medium (4032); and the hero panel is described as .box with rounded-xl (1962) while .box is rounded-lg.

The guide's sidebar utility table (2247-2252) documents compositions the CSS no longer has (backdrop with bg-gray-900, badge built by hand, section header p-3 semibold); it reads as stale documentation rather than a target.

Motion handling is per component (accessibility.css, autocomplete, login); one global prefers-reduced-motion rule covering animate-spin, transitions and keyframes would close the toast, copy-success, progress and photo-board gaps at once.

Muted ink is spelled six ways in the stylesheet layer (text-stone-muted, me-muted, text-base-content/60, text-body-subtle, text-stone-subtle, text-stone-icon); the /60 opacity spellings in progress and vc-applications sit off the documented ladder.

--color-info sits 2 degrees of hue from --color-primary, so info callouts, info badges and brand actions are the same blue; the guide warns blue is "spoken for twice over" (290) yet keeps the overlap.
The guide's two "sticky" button_row examples (1138-1142, 2848-2853) omit sticky: true, so as written they render an ordinary row.
The guide's modal example (1594-1599) wraps a button_row inside m.footer, but m.footer is already a button_row, so the sample nests one row in another.
The guide contradicts itself on stat-box labels: ui_stat_box :sm is documented with a text-xs label and :md with text-sm (1340-1341), while TYPE-02/TYPE-03 bar those sizes for labels a reader needs.
hero_panel's :h2 title is text-xl font-semibold (documented at 471), while TYPE-04 says every h2 takes heading-section; one of the two should give way.

export_csv_link is the code's one export affordance, but the guide's records-management examples (3401, 3450) still spell button_link "Export CSV", :secondary; naming the helper in the guide would stop that drift.
ui_callout_box defaults role="alert" for every type. An info, success or secondary note announced as an alert on each render is noisy; role="note" or none for static types would be calmer.
Status icons drawn without label: (record_title, qualification_icon, photo_tag fallback) leave screen-reader users without the state that sighted readers get from shape and colour.
tab_navigation names every tablist "Tabs"; taking a label from the caller would give each its own name.
modal defaults to size :lg (max-w-2xl) while its header comment says :md, so every confirm_modal_dialog opens at 2xl for a one-line question.
render_progress_bar floors progress to 5% and reports that in aria-valuenow, so "0 of 10" is announced as 5 percent.
back_to's hover goes from text-body to text-stone-emphasis, which resolve to the same token; the link has no visible hover change.
dropdown_item_disabled draws text-sm at base-content/40, likely below AA contrast; it has no callers, so this is latent.

Icon default style varies by helper (button_action, ui_section, ui_empty_state regular; ui_badge, ui_accent_card, ui_stat_box solid); one default would cut the regular-glyph raises fa_icon guards against.
Two progress-bar implementations coexist (ui_progress_bar utility-built, render_progress_bar custom CSS with gradient and pulse); the guide documents both without saying when to use which.
delete_button renders an a with data-turbo-method rather than a button, so a destructive action is announced as a link.
ui_disclosure :card bolds plain-string titles but not SafeBuffer ones, so two cards with the same title can differ in weight depending on how the caller built it.
clipboard_button meets the 36px floor through a before:-inset-3.5 pseudo-element rather than min-h-9; TOUCH-01 does not say whether that counts.

The guide's required-field text (asterisk plus SR "(required)") and the builder disagree in both directions; pick one marker (asterisk with sr-only text at text-sm or larger) and make check_box and radio honour required: too.

help_mode: :tooltip is documented as a peer of :inline but cannot reach keyboard or screen-reader users; either drop it from the guide or render the help in a focusable disclosure and keep the describedby target.

The `form fieldset` selector in components/forms.css styles every fieldset in a form, so builder radio groups (class mb-3) likely pick up the primary left border and gradient meant for f.fieldset; needs a rendered page to confirm.
A failed submit announces one role="alert" per invalid field plus the summary callout; consider role="alert" on the summary only and plain describedby text on fields.
A field's help text disappears while it shows an error (field_suffix); readers lose the hint at the moment they need it. Showing both with two ids in describedby would keep it.
Two error summaries and two form wrappers exist; common/_form_wrapper has no callers and common/_error_summary is used only by it. Removing both leaves ui_form as the single path.
The guide documents 120px textarea height and Vanilla Calendar for date_field/time_field (2498-2503); the code gives 80px and native pickers. Either the guide or the builder should move.
callsign_chips_field: the guide's "aria-label is Add a callsign" (2571) is stale; the code deliberately lets the visible label name the input. Update the guide.
RolesHelper#has_role? returns a truthy array for any signed-in user without checking the role; worth confirming which has_role? views resolve to, since ApplicationController also exposes one.
DateTimeHelper::CSV_TIME omits seconds while the guide's table lists CSV as "2026-01-08 14:30:00"; the guide row may simply need splitting into logs (seconds) and CSV (minutes).

filter_bar's panel (rounded-base border) and chip (hand-built pill) could reuse rounded-lg and a badge-like utility; the chip and the callsign chip are two hand-built pills with different padding and remove controls.

Stat-box labels are not in COPY-03's list, and the area is mixed: hq/timesheets/event_summary uses ALL CAPS (TOTAL HOURS, CREDITS, POSITIONS), while radio_checkout (Overdue radios, Radios flagged) and events_rangered (Not signed up) use sentence case beside Title Case siblings.

components/hq-window.css line 37 adds an md..lg tablet tier for .hq-shell that is not @media screen and is not in the BP-03 table (which documents only 1800px and 2400px); BP-01 limits md: to button-row stacking.

The HQ guided-flow accordion (_section) and suggested-task checklist (_todo_list, _todo_chip) say they are plan-approved, but neither is documented in DESIGN-GUIDE.md, so PROC-01 documentation looks outstanding.

The two radio report siblings switch views differently: Radio Assets shows one :primary button naming the other view; Radio Checkout shows both views with the current one filled. The guide has no toggle or segmented-control pattern.
Nine templates wrap a button_row in a bare div.my-4 or div.mb-4 just for spacing; a margin option on button_row (or a documented default) would remove the one-off wrapper.

Status sentences on the On-Site Registration page are coloured h3 headings (heading-title text-success/text-error); they read as notices and might belong in ui_callout_box rather than in the heading outline.

Tabs are the most serious JS finding: tabs_controller and camera_controller both use roving tabindex without arrow keys, so idle tabs are keyboard-unreachable on every tab_navigation page. Either add ArrowLeft/Right/Home/End or drop tabindex -1.

Four confirmation mechanisms coexist (Turbo dialog, native window.confirm in unsaved-changes, confirm_checkbox and permission-editor submit). A JS helper that opens confirm_modal_dialog markup through Turbo.config.forms.confirm would let them all use the app dialog.

animate-spin has no global prefers-reduced-motion override (accessibility.css only stops animate-pulse); the guide's claim that the approved set honours reduced motion is untrue for spinners anywhere, not only the autocomplete.
Icons set from JS as raw class strings (autocomplete spinner, hq-shift chips, table-sort) bypass fa_icon's regular-style check (ICON-03); the guide says nothing about icons drawn at runtime.
read-more defaults its toggle text to lowercase "more"/"less"; toggle swaps whole innerHTML labels. A single disclosure helper with documented label rules would settle both.

Silent failures: copy-to-clipboard empty catch, tabs remote fetch logs to console only, pod-people/sortable PATCH errors unhandled. The guide's "immediate feedback" preference suggests a visible failure state.
app/javascript/controllers/application.js sets Stimulus application.debug = true in every environment, logging every controller lifecycle event in production consoles.
photo-board auto-advances groups every 5s on a wall display; the guide's AVOID on carousels is aimed at reader pages, and an explicit kiosk exception would make that clear.

The dashboard step fragments carry ~15 one-line red text-error notices (several in ALL CAPS) inside status-coloured accent cards; the guide should say whether these are inline notices needing ui_callout_box, so they can be ranked consistently.

Typographic arrows ("→") are used as connectors in about 12 dashboard step fragments; the guide does not say whether such glyphs count as icons, and the same steps elsewhere use an arrow-right fa_icon.

Several buttons carry an aria-label that does not contain or differs from their visible text (_mvr_status_eligible:36 "Submit MVR Request", _pvr_status_eligible:12, _pvr_status_potential:20, vehicles index:46), which can break voice control (WCAG label-in-name); no guide rule covers it.

Dead or unrouted code: app/views/me/event_info.html.erb has no route and placeholder tab text; dashboard_tasks/_dashboard_survey.html.erb has no caller; DashboardHelper#dashboard_step_status_class and #dashboard_step_icon have no caller.

The awards page shows a reference info callout ("What These Awards Recognize") in its body; if the page counts as a report under HELP-02, that belongs in a collapsed About card. The guide's report-or-operated test does not clearly classify a page with no controls.
Ticket claim actions use :success on sap.html and review.html but :primary on vehicle_pass.html and ticket.html; one variant for "claim" across the ticket wizard would read more consistently.
Many TYPE-03 and TYPE-04 judgments in dashboard steps assume the ui_accent_card title renders as heading-title (text-base); a rendered page would confirm whether text-lg lines outweigh it.

Three print views (acceptance print_sheets, mentor assignments print_sheet, pods print_sheet) copy the _print_screen_nav block inline, and the pods sheet copies _sheet_masthead by hand; one partial with label and hint locals would remove the drift.

The guide has no print-sheet pattern (back link outside a hero, masthead, @page rules in content_for :page_rules), so every sheet here reads as a HERO-01, HERO-04 and STYLE-01 departure; documenting it would turn these into one ruled exception.
Several filtered pages pair filter_bar's primary "Apply Filters" with the page's own primary submit; the guide could say whether the filter bar's submit counts toward BTN-04.

Alpha Sign-Out and Mentor Shift Report deliberately use an :error callout for live data and a :success callout for neutral shift info; a neutral or info variant would carry that without borrowing status colours.
alpha_pods/index badges the pod count in :primary and the empty state in :secondary; primary for a count sits uneasily with COLOR-04 (primary for primary actions and key elements).
The Training Notes box on the acceptance form prints empty when there are no passed trainings while the other notes boxes print a sentence; the inconsistency shows on paper.

Create-form heroes say "New Access Document", "New Banner", "New Certification", "New FKA", "New Pog", "New Missing Timesheet Request" while the buttons that open them say "Add ..."; COPY-04 covers action labels, not page titles, but the reader sees two verbs.

The same fact is drawn several ways across the area: "inactive" as red "[inactive]" text (_position_checkbox) and as ui_badge (_team_card); "Still On Duty" as a :warning badge (timesheets helper) and as red italic text (timesheets/log); the change arrow as fa_icon (access_documents/history) and as → (_log_entry_data).

Count lines use four neutral treatments: me-muted (applications, certifications, status_history, tickets_provisions), text-body (scheduling/log), text-base-content/80 (pogs, swag) and no class (timesheets/index). One count-line helper would settle it.
Vintage is ui_badge :secondary in the overview hero but :success on callsigns/edit.
timesheet_status_badges paints "Correction Requested" :error and "Correction Rejected" :warning, so the pending state reads as more alarming than the rejected one.
person/banners shows the same two visibility callouts on the index and again inside the form; on the form they could be one.
callsigns/edit hides the Release Callsign action below lg with "hidden lg:flex", so the action does not exist on a phone.
ui_label_value uses label_width "9rem" in contact details and "7rem" in the summary strip on the same page; certifications/show hand-builds the same display with grid-cols-[8rem_1fr].
intake_notes/edit shouts "ADD A NEW NOTE." in capitals inside the warning; bold alone would carry it.
Person::TimesheetsHelper#timesheet_status_icon and #missing_request_status_icon have no callers and could be deleted.
site_log's filter submit is :secondary while timesheets/index's is the default primary; filter_bar submits should agree.

Several pages wrap the whole body in an untitled ui_section (applications, certifications/index, status_history, empty states on scheduling/log and site_log); the guide never says whether a section may be untitled.

Apply Filters is the default primary variant on hq_forecast, burn_perimeters, sandman, schedule_by_callsign, shift_coverage, shift_drop and shift_signups but :secondary on early_arrivals, shift_lead, slots, credits and the copy pages; one convention would help.
The Inactive slot badge is :secondary (slot_status_badge, Inactive position badges) on most pages but :warning in slots/position record_title and "N inactive" on slots/index.
Icon-only edit_link on position credits versus a text "Edit Slot" edit_link on slots/position, two sibling records pages.
Activate All / Deactivate All on slots/position change every slot of a position in one click with no confirmation.
flake_report/position.html.erb:94 builds an empty-state message with .html_safe around an interpolated string; safe today (integers only) but fragile.
layouts/print, layouts/photo_board and layouts/bookmark render no flash at all. Harmless only if no controller sets flash before landing on those pages; that cannot be checked from the views.

The door pages (sign in, forgot, reset, SSO) form their own consistent family: amber :warning lg submits, sessions/_heading, login.css panels, warning-tinted icons. The guide documents login.css and a motion exception but no hero or button exception; one written ruling would settle a dozen findings.
sessions/forgot.html.erb shows a "Reset Password Disabled" warning above a working reset form; if the feature really is off, the form should not render, and if it is on, the notice is stale.
profile/_alerts yes/no icons have no text alternative, so a screen reader hears empty SMS/Email cells; fa_icon label: (as ICON-04 describes) would fix it.

Copy errors: profile/show:62 "Be alerted when to when new Clubhouse Message are received"; profile/_mailing_address:8-9 "to update update your profile"; layouts/me/timesheet:9 "Any timesheet entry ... are placeholders"; profile/show:49 says "Withdraw Photo" but the button reads "Withdraw".
The search mode segmented control shows the selected mode only by a primary fill (has-[:checked]:bg-primary); worth a check that the checked segment reads as selected without colour.
The search dialog input is named by aria-label while the visible mode hint above it is not tied to it; tying the hint by aria-labelledby or aria-describedby would match FORM-02's intent.
_dialog_status titles are h3 inside dialogs that have no h2; h2 would keep the dialog's own outline clean.
Register step chips use sentence-case questions ("Why are you here?") as labels; COPY-03 does not list badges, but they read as headings.
application/_recipient_avatar has no partial caller per the Phase 1 agent; it may be dead.
profile_photos/new "must NOT have" and profile/_mailing_address "are NOT synced" use capitals for emphasis.
Retention Report's table comment says it "stays a table and scrolls sideways", but the ui_table call omits responsive: false, so it folds to cards; the comment or the call is stale.
Hero titles "New Position", "New Team" and "New Position Lineup" use the verb COPY-04 bans on buttons; the guide does not say whether a form page's title follows the Add verb.

Apply Filters is :secondary on every teams_positions page, certificates and languages_known, but default primary on people_by_location, retention, unified flagging and status change pages; the area disagrees with itself.

Level-1 drill indexes split two ways: text-lg count line (certificates, people_by_status, status change, roster, team documents) versus filter_bar count slot (membership, position grants, people_by_location).
status_change_vintage puts aria-label on a role-less span, which assistive tech usually ignores; roster_management_helper's NOT_GRANTED uses sr-only text for the same job.
Position Grants detail prints a bare "—" for not on site with no screen-reader text, while the on-site icon carries sr-only "On site".
The amber text-warning count on the roster cards, and the opacity-75 clear rows on the sanity board, need a rendered contrast check in both themes.
Special Teams Hours collects its report parameters in a ui_form inside a "Report Parameters" disclosure rather than a filter_bar; it reads as a run form, but it narrows the table the way filters do.
Edit-page hero descriptions ("Training #12 — 5 people granted it, 3 shifts.") describe the record, not what the page does.
Read-only permission grants show as plain divs on the position form and as secondary badges on the team form.
bmid/manage/_edit_grid renders the same primary "Save All Changes" submit at top (34) and bottom (157); worth deciding whether a duplicated primary meets BTN-04.
The Skipped-items list exists three times: ticketing/trs_export/_skipped, bmid/export/_skipped and inline in bmid/export/unsubmit.html.erb:41-49. Candidate for one shared partial.
The "Missing" arrival alarm is a shared partial (_summary_missing) but records.html.erb:66-68 inlines a copy without whitespace-nowrap.
Count headlines above ledgers vary: div text-lg (three results pages), p text-lg (maintenance/preview), ui_stat_row (bmid results pages). No rule settles which.
Boolean display varies: yes_no_badge, plain Yes/No (ticketing/provisions:68, bmid/badges/edit:80), and Yes/— (bmid tables). A rule would help.
Filter bar Apply is default primary on ticketing and sanity check but :secondary on bmid manage and export; on trs_export/index the default creates a second primary.
bmid/manage/index:120 empty message says "matching the filter criteria" on the branch where no filter is active.
The bmid Edit Mode / Table View switch is one primary or secondary button_link; a mode toggle may read better as tabs or a segmented control.
maintenance/results has no Back button in its empty state while unsubmit_provisions/results and maintenance/preview do.
Field widths with lg: (trs_export/index:75 "w-full lg:w-96", bmid/export/index:79) differ from the guide's sm: width convention.

Three table partials carry comments saying "desktop-first, scrolling sideways rather than restacking" (early_late_checkins/_section 28, forced_shift_start 77, timesheet_unconfirmed/_group 9) while the code keeps the responsive default; the comments mislead.
Every filter bar sets its fields width: "w-full" with wrapper_class "flex-1"; FORM-07's width table does not say how fields inside filter_bar should size.
Stat-box labels mix Title Case and sentence case on one row (On Duty: "On duty", "Out Longer Than Usual", "No shift attached"; slot repair "Shift to add"); COPY-03 does not list stat labels.
Drill-down meta lines join parts with " • " on three pages (by position, by callsign, totals) and " · " everywhere else; one separator would read as one system.
The ROC Photo Board is an unattended wall display with its own layout and CSS; a written kiosk exception would settle HERO-01 and the custom headings, cards and badges.

Cruise Direction and Roll Call pickers are deliberate auto-submitting GET form_tags (the set-time dialog comment calls them the year_selector navigation pattern); the guide could document an auto-submit picker so FORM-01 stops flagging them.
Hours & Credits hand-writes its thead, so the builder never collects column labels; whether the table folds into labelled cards below lg needs a rendered check at phone width.
Sanity checker dims clear checks with opacity-75 on ui_drill_down_row; contrast in both themes needs a rendered check.

Several modal and dialog paragraphs explain in text-sm or as red bold text where a callout already exists beside them (unavailable, people/_dialog, set-time and blocked dialogs); one callout per message would be calmer.

clipboard_button is called without label: on completed_training/show (two tables) and multiple_enrollments (one per section), so several icon-only buttons share the name "Copy to clipboard"; the helper's own comment asks for a label wherever a page shows more than one, and the visible "Copy N addresses" text is not part of the button.

"Add <callsign>" and "Add Anyway" submit an add directly, while COPY-04 reserves "Add X" for opening a create form; the rule has no verb for adding a person to a group (its counterpart to "Remove from X").
rosters/_blocked falls back to "The sign-up was refused [<status>]." which prints a raw verdict code to the reader.
The mentor assignment roster's back link reads "Choose another shift" (aria "Back to Choose another shift"), a verb phrase in sentence case where every sibling page's back_to names a page.

The work history dialog opens with a visible three-sentence explanation (what is counted, what is excluded, how to drill down); HELP-02 does not say whether a report-style dialog should fold this into a card.

The capacity, completed-training, multiple-enrollments and trainer-attendance pages put Export CSV in a button_row inside a bare my-4 div, while their filtered siblings put it in filter_bar actions:, so the export sits in two places across the area.
The mentoring landing has no back link while its three sub-pages back to it; the session landing likewise has none.
_notes_list, photos_review/_photo and info hand-write <h3 class="heading-title text-heading mb-2">, the exact classes ui_subheading emits; ui_subheading would keep them in step.

VC stage cards title each stage with a span inside <summary>, so the review page's main column has no headings between the h1 and the rail's h2s; a screen-reader user cannot jump between stages by heading.
application_status_badge prints "Bug [status]" to reviewers for an unknown status; a neutral fallback label would read better.
Lone buttons (export links in mt-3 divs on application_import, the upload commit submit) sit outside button_row; BTN-07 does not say whether a single button needs one, worth ruling on.
The "Vintage" handle-type badge uses :error though vintage is not an error state; :warning may fit the meaning better.
Spigot Flow headings are right-aligned (right: true) while every cell is centred (center: true), so columns do not line up with their headings.
reset_pnvs empty state reads "Odd, no qualified applicants were found." — a tone departure from the other empty states; no copy rule names it.
Several dialog fields (approve_callsign, edit_approved_handle, assign, adjust_status) rely on the builder default w-auto width; FORM-07 does not say whether that default counts as fitted.

components.name: daisyUI themes list
components.note: Two themes, light default, no prefersdark; the one dark switch is the .dark class set by theme_controller, as the guide's Dark Mode Implementation (993) says.

components.name: --color-base-100
components.note: Warm paper light (hue 80), cool dark (hue 260), as guide 154-155 states; documented as the card and panel surface (400).

components.name: --color-base-200
components.note: Hue 80 light / 260 dark per 154-155; documented secondary surface (401).

components.name: --color-base-300
components.note: Hue 80 / 260 per 154-155; documented form fills, progress tracks and the row-hover fill used for contrast measurement (402, 950).

components.name: --color-base-content
components.note: L 40 light / 75 dark, warm hue in both (60/80) as 155 says; matches the text-body row of the ladder table (955).

components.name: --color-primary
components.note: oklch(0.52 0.2 262) light / oklch(0.68 0.19 262) dark, exactly the Signal Blue values at 156-157.

components.name: --color-primary-content
components.note: Ink on a primary fill (white light, near-black dark); the guide names btn-primary but never states this token's value.

components.name: --color-secondary
components.note: Zero-chroma grey light, low-chroma grey dark; the guide documents badge-secondary as "Neutral gray" (892) and btn-secondary as a variant.

components.name: --color-secondary-content
components.note: Ink on a secondary fill; value not documented.

components.name: --color-accent
components.note: Purple accent token the guide never mentions; no *-accent utility found in views, helpers, controllers or lib. A second chromatic accent beside Signal Blue (157 says primary is the only one) left defined but unused.

components.name: --color-accent-content
components.note: Ink on accent; undocumented, unused with the accent token.

components.name: --color-neutral
components.note: Dark neutral; the guide documents it as the copy tip's bg-neutral (1768). Otherwise undocumented.

components.name: --color-neutral-content
components.note: Copy tip ink text-neutral-content (1768); navbar ghost ink (2087 refers to navbar.css). Value undocumented.

components.name: --color-info
components.note: Documented as icon-info / text-info and toast-info "Blue info colors" (633, 877). Hue 260 sits 2 degrees from primary's 262, so info and brand read as one blue.

components.name: --color-info-content
components.note: Ink on an info fill; value undocumented.

components.name: --color-success
components.note: Semantic success token, documented as text-success, bg-success, bg-success/10 (392, 405-406).

components.name: --color-success-content
components.note: White on success in both themes; the guide does not document it (memory notes dark 3.62:1, a contrast question for a rendered check).

components.name: --color-warning
components.note: Semantic amber status token, documented at 393, 407-408 and 180 ("amber is a status color").

components.name: --color-warning-content
components.note: Ink on a warning fill; value undocumented.

components.name: --color-error
components.note: Semantic error token, documented at 394, 409-410.

components.name: --color-error-content
components.note: Ink on an error fill; value undocumented.

components.name: --radius-selector
components.note: daisyUI radius for badge, checkbox, toggle (1rem, a pill at badge height); guide's radius table speaks of classes only. No rounded-selector call sites.

components.name: --radius-field
components.note: Guide radius table: buttons and inputs take rounded-base, 12px (588). daisyUI draws every btn and input at --radius-field, 0.5rem (8px), so ButtonHelper buttons and builder inputs are 8px while rounded-base call sites are 12px.

components.name: --radius-box
components.note: 0.75rem = the 12px card radius the guide states for card-standard (707-708).

components.name: --size-selector
components.note: daisyUI selector size unit; undocumented.

components.name: --size-field
components.note: Base unit daisyUI multiplies for control height; accessibility.css takes 9 x 0.25rem = 36px, the floor the guide states (572-574).

components.name: --border
components.note: daisyUI component border width 1px; undocumented.

components.name: --depth
components.note: daisyUI depth 1 adds subtle shadows and gradients to btn, input and similar; the guide's flat-by-default note (610) does not mention it. Rendered check needed to see what it paints.

components.name: --noise
components.note: daisyUI noise texture off; undocumented.

components.name: --font-sans
components.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible then the guide's fallback stack (431-432); CSS appends four emoji families the guide's block omits, which changes nothing for text.

components.name: --font-mono
components.note: Guide stack (433-434) lists ui-monospace and monospace as generic keywords; CSS quotes them ("ui-monospace", "monospace"), which makes them family names that match nothing, so if the mono woff2 fails the fallback is the next named font, never the generic.

components.name: --color-default / --color-default-soft / --color-default-strong
components.note: Aliases of base-200/100/300 (bg-default in 18 files); undocumented third spelling of the surface tokens. default-soft and text-default unused.

components.name: --color-heading
components.note: L 30 light / 85 dark, the values in the neutral ladder table (954); dark set under .dark and [data-theme=dark] as 1037 asks.

components.name: --color-body
components.note: var(--color-base-content), L 40/75, as the ladder table says (955).

components.name: --color-body-subtle
components.note: L 50 light / 66 dark, matching the ladder table (957). The table lists text-body-subtle as a valid spelling while the CSS comment (136-138) calls it unused on purpose.

components.name: --color-line
components.note: border-line is the documented standard border (416, 711); value undocumented. L 30 light is heading-dark ink, lifted to L 52 in dark.

components.name: --color-chrome
components.note: oklch(0% 0 0) = #000000, the drawer and section background documented at 2097 and 2107.

components.name: --color-sidebar-content
components.note: oklch(95.5% 0 0), documented as #f0f0f0 (2097, 2109); comment says it round-trips exactly.

components.name: --color-sidebar-link
components.note: Slate item background documented as #3e4348 (2098).

components.name: --color-sidebar-link-hq
components.note: Khaki item background documented as #524737 for the admin theme (2103).

components.name: --color-sidebar-title-hq
components.note: Dark brown section background documented as #3d2503 (2102).

components.name: --color-sidebar-divider
components.note: Documented as #101010 (2108).

components.name: --color-sidebar-active
components.note: #ffc107 kept as hex, the documented legacy exception (187-188, 2110).

components.name: --color-signature-edge
components.note: One of the three documented legacy amber pieces, a theme token with its own dark value (180-184).

components.name: --color-hero-tile
components.note: Documented legacy amber stat tile token with dark twin (181-183).

components.name: --color-hero-tile-content
components.note: Documented legacy amber tile ink with dark twin (181-183).

components.name: --text-2xs
components.note: 0.625rem size, absent from the type-scale table (465-474); unused. Any use would fall under TYPE-02's ban on tiny text.

components.name: --text-base / --text-base--line-height
components.note: 0.9rem on 1.2, exactly as 461-463 and the scale table (469) state.

components.name: --text-lg
components.note: 1.1rem, the scale table's text-lg (470).

components.name: --spacing-8xl
components.note: 90rem size token, undocumented and unused.

components.name: --spacing-list-indent
components.note: 1.5em, the list indent the guide names (557-558).

components.name: --font-size
components.note: daisyUI base size set to 0.9rem, the same as text-base (461).

components.name: --leading-4..9
components.note: leading-4..9 redefined in px (16-36px); the guide states only text-base's 1.2 leading (461-463). leading-4 and leading-9 unused.

components.name: --leading-heading-none
components.note: 60px line-height token; undocumented and unused.

components.name: --tracking-tight / --tracking-tighter
components.note: Letter-spacing in px (-0.4px / -0.8px); undocumented. tracking-tight in 1 file, tracking-tighter unused.

components.name: --radius-0 / -xxs / -xs / -sm / --radius / -base / -lg
components.note: radius-base 12px and radius-lg 16px match the radius table (588-589); xl/2xl aliases come from Tailwind defaults (12px/16px). radius-0, xxs, xs, sm and --radius are undocumented; 0 and xxs unused.

components.name: --default-border-width
components.note: Bare border width 1px; undocumented.

components.name: --container-brand
components.note: 7rem container size for the phone navbar brand (@min-brand, 1 file); undocumented.

components.name: @custom-variant dark
components.note: dark: keyed on the .dark class, as 993 and 1037 describe.

components.name: @source list
components.note: Tailwind content sources (javascript, config, views, helpers, lib; not the Lexxy bundle); build configuration the guide does not address.

components.name: --lexxy-* re-theme
components.note: Points Lexxy's variables at app tokens so both themes follow, as 2548-2551 describe; toolbar button 2.25rem keeps the 36px floor. accent-medium mixes literal #000 (38).

components.name: --button-row-gap
components.note: 1.5vh row gap, the figure the sticky-spacer section uses (2862).

components.name: --button-row-pad-bottom
components.note: max(1rem, safe-area inset), the home-indicator inset the spacer section counts (2862).

components.name: --hero-stat-hue
components.note: Guide: non-semantic amber is three documented legacy pieces, not to be extended (180-188). hero-stat-award pins a new gold, oklch(50% 0.13 85) / oklch(83% 0.17 90), and flame mixes warning into error for decoration.

components.name: --ct-s1..s8, --ct-grid
components.note: Chart series palette, 16 hex plus #898781, dark set under .dark only; charts have no rule.

components.name: --login-drop / --login-cut
components.note: Black alphas for the login panel drop shadow and field inset, light and dark values; login styling beyond the file's existence is undocumented.

components.name: --photo-board-header-height
components.note: Sticky header offset for the ROC photo board, overwritten by JS.

components.name: --zoom
components.note: 1.15 at 112.5rem (1800px) and 1.35 at 150rem (2400px) under @media screen, the HQ shared-display tier at 2976-2988.

components.name: turbo-frame
components.note: ambiguous STYLE-01: the rule bans CSS outside components/, yet 3944 lists base.css for exactly these element styles. Layered display:block.

components.name: main
components.note: bg-base-100 token, layered; base.css is listed as the home for main (3944).

components.name: kbd
components.note: font-mono on a key legend, a literal string, which 441-444 allows.

components.name: p
components.note: Layered mb-2 on every paragraph; base.css listed at 3944, no spacing rule states a paragraph gap.

components.name: a:not(.no-decoration)
components.note: Every link gets text-primary underline unless it carries no-decoration; plain links have no rule.

components.name: button
components.note: cursor-pointer on every button; undocumented.

components.name: *, ::before, ::after
components.note: Ring-offset gap painted base-100 instead of #fff so focus rings do not glare in dark mode; undocumented.

components.name: iOS focus zoom guard
components.note: Unlayered 1rem font-size on focused fields under pointer:coarse + -webkit-touch-callout, stopping iOS zoom; undocumented.

components.name: th:not(.text-center):not(.text-end):not(.text-right)
components.note: Unlayered left-aligned th; uses physical left, not start. Undocumented.

components.name: table
components.note: Global tabular-nums on tables, exactly what 452-454 says.

components.name: mark
components.note: Takes the browser highlighter off every <mark>, as 781-782 documents.

components.name: form fieldset / form fieldset > legend
components.note: Guide: gradients belong to progress components only, never cards or other elements (757-760); colour is never decoration (COLOR-02). Every form fieldset gets a primary left rule and a primary/5 gradient. Legend text-lg semibold matches 470/4034.

components.name: .navbar padding
components.note: Navbar side padding max(0.5rem, safe-area inset) for notched phones; undocumented.

components.name: .drawer-side > aside
components.note: Sidebar start padding for the left safe-area inset; undocumented.

components.name: @font-face Atkinson Hyperlegible (4 faces)
components.note: Self-hosted woff2, variable 200-800 with italics, as 427-428 and 446-447 state.

components.name: @font-face Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono (4 faces)
components.note: Mono cut self-hosted with the same four faces (427-428, 441).

components.name: @media (prefers-reduced-motion) .animate-pulse
components.note: Guide: the approved motion, animate-spin spinners included, must honour prefers-reduced-motion (3218-3219). The only global guard stops animate-pulse; Tailwind animate-spin (5 views) has none, only sso/hand_back adds motion-reduce.

components.name: touch-target floor .btn-sm, .select-sm, .btn-toast-close
components.note: Lifts daisyUI sm to 9 x --size-field = 36px, the floor stated at 572-574.

components.name: @media print .disclosure-card
components.note: Hides a closed explanation card from print; the guide does not address printing the HELP-02 card.

components.name: print rules (all)
components.note: Four @media print blocks unfreeze sticky columns and uncap panes; print sheets use @media screen paper previews. The guide mentions print only for tables (1512).

components.name: breakpoints in media queries
components.note: Guide: md marks only button-row stacking and its spacer (2947-2961). hq-window.css:37 adds an md-to-lg band laying the HQ summary out as a row. Literal 1024px also at mega-menu.css:20, label-value.css:33 (BP-02).

components.name: link
components.note: @utility text-primary underline applied to every bare <a>; plain links have no rule.

components.name: no-decoration
components.note: Opt-out marker from the link style, no declarations; undocumented (20 files).

components.name: tap-target-link
components.note: inline-flex items-center min-h-9, the min-h-9 floor 575-576 prescribes for a bare link. The utility name itself is undocumented.

components.name: instruction-list
components.note: dl space-y-1 text-body, dt bold heading ps-5 with Q: in primary, dd ps-5 with A: muted, alt-text content, dd+dt spacing: matches 674-689 line for line.

components.name: button-row
components.note: Guide: button-row gaps are gap-2 or gap-4 (553). The row uses 1.5vh row gap and 1.5vw column gap, viewport-relative (about 6px on a phone, 29px at 1920). md stacking is the sanctioned use (2952).

components.name: button-row-spacer
components.note: Height derived from control count, --size, gaps and pad; one line from md unless full-width; hidden at lg: matches 2955-2959 and 2862-2876.

components.name: btn-copy-success
components.note: Guide: motion is functional only, from an approved set, and honours prefers-reduced-motion (3218-3220). Keyframed scale bounce and zoom-fade on copy (3 call sites), no reduced-motion rule; the guide's copy confirmation has no animation (1769).

components.name: copy-tip
components.note: bg-neutral, text-neutral-content, text-sm, no tail, no animation, anchored above with flip and a fallback box: matches 1768-1772.

components.name: btn-toast-close
components.note: @apply btn btn-ghost btn-sm btn-circle, lifted to 36px by accessibility.css:21. The class itself is undocumented.

components.name: [data-theme="dark"] .btn-error
components.note: A theme patch darkening the error fill in dark; 931-932 says buttons.css holds theme patches. Literal oklch(42% 0.15 25) inside a component file, which 1014 tolerates.

components.name: icon-success / icon-warning / icon-error / icon-info
components.note: Map to text-success / text-warning / text-error / text-info exactly as 630-633 state.

components.name: flex-center
components.note: flex items-center, the documented "maps to" (650); the name suggests justify-center, which it does not set.

components.name: flex-center-gap-2
components.note: flex items-center gap-2, as 651 documents.

components.name: inline-flex-center-gap-2
components.note: inline-flex items-center gap-2, as 653 documents.

components.name: inline-flex-center
components.note: Guide documents inline-flex-center mapping to inline-flex items-center (645, 652). No such @utility exists in flex-patterns.css, so the class would compile to nothing; no call site uses it.

components.name: list-bulleted / list-numbered
components.note: list-disc / list-decimal plus ps-list-indent, as 556-559 state.

components.name: two-column-lg
components.note: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4, the documented two-column wrapper; the utility name itself is not in the guide.

components.name: stack-to-row-lg
components.note: flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-4, the documented column wrapper (CARD-03, LAYOUT-02); the name is undocumented.

components.name: card-standard
components.note: card bg-base-100 border border-line, no padding, no shadow, 12px from --radius-box: matches 707-715.

components.name: table-container
components.note: Overflow, shadow-xs, border base-300, rounded-box, as 1442 describes ("overflow, shadow, border, rounded corners").

components.name: table-header / table-heading / table-row-header / table-cell-td
components.note: table-header bg-base-200 matches 1443 "medium background"; table-heading, table-row-header and table-cell-td (p-1.5) are undocumented. Cells set no size, so content stays text-base.

components.name: table-row-base / table-row-hover / table-row-striped
components.note: Opaque base-100 row, hover base-300, odd/even base-100/base-200: match 1444-1446.

components.name: table-detail-row / table-detail-cell
components.note: Expanded detail row on base-200 with a primary left rule (border-s-4 border-primary); undocumented.

components.name: responsive-table
components.note: Folds below lg via (width < theme(--breakpoint-lg)), labels from data-label at text-xs (allowed for mobile table labels, 484), wrapping fields with an 11rem floor (2940, 1452-1462).

components.name: text-heading-primary
components.note: color var(--color-heading), the same rung as text-heading per the ladder table (954).

components.name: text-stone-emphasis
components.note: color var(--color-body), same rung as text-body (955).

components.name: text-stone-muted
components.note: 90% base-content toward base-100, the documented muted step (956).

components.name: text-stone-subtle / text-stone-icon
components.note: Both var(--color-body-subtle), as the ladder table lists (957).

components.name: heading-section
components.note: text-base lg:text-lg font-semibold, as 532-533 state. The quick reference table (4032) says section titles are font-medium, contradicting 533.

components.name: heading-title
components.note: text-base font-semibold, as 533-534 state.

components.name: modal-header-bar / modal-title-text / modal-body-content / modal-footer-bar
components.note: Guide: modal titles take text-heading-primary (971). modal-title-text sets text-xl font-semibold text-base-content, body ink at L40 rather than heading ink. The four utilities are otherwise undocumented (the guide shows daisyUI modal-box/modal-action).

components.name: dropdown-panel
components.note: menu bg-base-100 rounded-box shadow-lg w-52 p-2 border base-300; the guide's dropdown example uses shadow-sm and no border (848). Utility name undocumented.

components.name: dropdown-link / dropdown-disabled-item
components.note: Item px-4 py-2 text-sm hover base-200 rounded-lg re-declared beside daisyUI menu items; disabled at base-content/40. text-sm is allowed for dropdown menus (504). Undocumented.

components.name: toast-base
components.note: Guide: entrance animations are decorative and avoided; approved motion must honour prefers-reduced-motion (3218-3220). Toasts slide in from translateX(100%) over 300ms with no reduced-motion rule. Composition matches 875.

components.name: toast-progress
components.note: Approved motion lists spinners, the progress pulse, urgent badges, the sidebar slide (3218-3219). The toast countdown bar animates its width with no reduced-motion rule; undocumented class.

components.name: toast-success / toast-info / toast-warning / toast-error
components.note: daisyUI alert-<status> alert-soft, the green, blue, amber and red the table at 873-879 describes.

components.name: sidebar-nav-item
components.note: Composition matches 2250 word for word (h-10 = 40px clears the floor). Active state is an unlayered color plus 5px right border instead of the !text-sidebar-active utilities 2161-2162 name; same look.

components.name: sidebar-section-header
components.note: Guide composition: p-3 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider overflow-hidden text-ellipsis (2251). CSS: px-3 py-1 text-sm uppercase overflow-hidden text-ellipsis, no semibold, no tracking, tighter vertical padding.

components.name: sidebar-badge
components.note: Guide composition: inline-flex min-w-[1.125rem] h-4.5 ms-2 px-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-full (2252). CSS: @apply badge badge-sm ms-2, daisyUI's small badge instead.

components.name: sidebar-link-hq / sidebar-group-title-hq / sidebar-link-default / sidebar-group-title-default
components.note: Token pairs match the theme variants at 2095-2103 (default: chrome title, sidebar-link item; admin: brown title, khaki item).

components.name: .drawer-side .btn-ghost
components.note: Sets --btn-rest-fg and outline-color to sidebar-content, exactly as 2085-2088 documents.

components.name: .navbar .btn-ghost:not(dialog *)
components.note: Same --btn-rest-fg technique for the bar, which 2087-2088 cites; the aria-current resting rule is undocumented.

components.name: messages-conversation-item
components.note: Mailbox row: flex gap-3 p-3 min-h-18, hover base-300 via default-strong, inset primary focus ring; undocumented.

components.name: messages-conversation-unread
components.note: bg-warning/10 for unread rows, the tint 778-779 names as the mailbox's unread vocabulary. Whether text also marks unread is a markup question.

components.name: search-hit
components.note: bg-warning/30 text-inherit rounded-sm, identical to 775.

components.name: messages-reply-editor
components.note: Shorter rich-text box (6rem) for the reply editor; comment cites owner approval, guide silent.

components.name: messages-conversation-avatar / messages-avatar-placeholder / messages-avatar-rbs / messages-avatar-team
components.note: 48px avatar boxes: rounded-lg base-300 placeholders with subtle-ink glyph, RBS on primary/10; avatars have no rule.

components.name: mega-menu-dialog
components.note: Guide: write the lg fold as theme(--breakpoint-lg) (2924-2925). Uses @media (min-width: 1024px); min-width avoids the overlap bug. Otherwise undocumented: full-screen dialog, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5) backdrop, shadow-xl.

components.name: mega-menu-header / -search / -tabs / -body / -side / -side-divider / -panels / -frame / -content
components.note: Mega menu shell: border-line dividers, search field min-h-9 text-base, w-64 side column; the guide only names the mega menu in passing (2083).

components.name: mega-menu-chrome-btn
components.note: Applied to button_action (btn-sm, height 36px), so its min-h-8 is inert; aria-current adds bg-secondary/30 and heading ink. Confirm rendered height on a page.

components.name: mega-menu-panel[hidden] / mega-menu-item[hidden]
components.note: display:none !important so [hidden] beats the file's own unlayered display rules.

components.name: mega-menu-panel-title / mega-menu-section-title
components.note: Guide: <h3>/<h4> take heading-title, one style per level (532-534). These go on <h3> (text-lg semibold muted) and <h4> (text-sm semibold muted) in me/menu/_content: own sizes and muted ink on headings.

components.name: mega-menu-item / -item-link / -item-title / -item-cat / -item-desc
components.note: Guide: 36px floor, min-h-9 for a bare link (572-576). mega-menu-item-link is a link with py-1 and min-h-8 (32px); a title-only item measures about 25px of content, so it renders 32px.

components.name: mega-menu-star / -star-on / -star-spacer
components.note: Star is an icon-only button_action given btn-square (577); min-h-9 and min-w-8 are redundant under btn-sm. Star-on uses text-primary.

components.name: mega-menu-cat-btn / -cat-text / -cat-chevron / -back / -close
components.note: cat-btn h-auto min-h-14; back and close are helper buttons whose btn-sm height (36px) outranks the inert min-h-8. Confirm rendered heights.

components.name: app-edge-pad
components.note: Page scroller padding 0.75rem with safe-area insets; undocumented.

components.name: box
components.note: The documented hero-panel shadow (607) and the region lift that 610 assigns to .box; rounded-lg 16px fits "panels not cards" (589).

components.name: box-accent
components.note: border-l-4 rounded-lg geometry behind notice_box_helper's accent callouts; the class is undocumented (helpers ui_callout_box accent: and ui_accent_card are).

components.name: box-hover
components.note: Hover is a fill change to base-300, never a lift, as 610-611 asks.

components.name: box-default
components.note: bg-base-100 border-line tokens.

components.name: box-success / box-accent-success
components.note: Guide token tables: success borders border-success/30, soft surfaces bg-success/10 (406, 419). The success callout uses bg-success/5 and border-success/20.

components.name: box-warning / box-accent-warning
components.note: Guide: warning borders border-warning/30 (420). The warning callout uses a full-strength border-warning, and an unlayered rule forces every descendant except .btn/.badge to amber ink, body text included.

components.name: box-error / box-accent-error
components.note: Guide token tables: border-error/30, bg-error/10 (409-410, 421). The error callout uses bg-error/5 and border-error/20.

components.name: box-info / box-accent-info
components.note: bg-info/10 border-info/30 with body ink (unlike other variants' status ink); the guide's border table has no info row.

components.name: box-secondary / box-accent-secondary
components.note: bg-base-300/90 body ink, no border colour; the :secondary callout variant is named (1745) but not styled in the guide.

components.name: box-theme-success / -warning / -error / -info / -secondary
components.note: @utility sources used only by @apply inside boxes.css; unused in markup.

components.name: me-hero-panel
components.note: Identical to the block at 1045-1049, rounded then rounded-lg included; the amber ring is the documented signature-edge legacy (180-184).

components.name: me-muted
components.note: @apply text-stone-muted, as 1057-1060 shows.

components.name: hero-stat / hero-stat-flame / hero-stat-award / hero-stat-label / hero-stat-value
components.note: Guide: never text-xs for labels a reader needs (489-494). hero-stat-label is 0.75rem. Also a decorative warning-to-error gradient (flame) and a new pinned gold (award) against 180-188; values off the type scale.

components.name: ac-results / ac-results-above / ac-results-inline
components.note: The documented results container (2349); shadow-lg fits "popovers, menus" (601). Forced thin scrollbar and inline variant undocumented.

components.name: ac-option / ac-option-active
components.note: Guide: ac-option-active is the keyboard-selected option "with brand ring" (2351). CSS paints an 18% success-green tint and a 3px inset green bar, no brand ring. ac-option min-h-9 matches 2350.

components.name: ac-group / ac-group-header
components.note: Guide: never text-xs for labels users need (494). The group header that names each result group is text-xs uppercase muted. Separator between groups matches 2352.

components.name: ac-filter-bar / ac-searching
components.note: Sticky filter-chip container as documented (2354); searching indicator min-h-9 text-sm muted.

components.name: ac-filter-chip / ac-filter-chip-active / ac-filter-count
components.note: Guide: text-xs only for badges and similar, never labels a reader needs (480-494). Filter chips, toggle controls, label at text-xs; min-h-9 and focus ring match. Active hover mixes in literal black.

components.name: ac-empty / ac-error / ac-loading
components.note: Guide: never text-sm for empty-state messages (518). ac-empty is text-sm muted. ac-error text-sm is allowed (507); ac-loading has no rule.

components.name: ac-keyboard-help (+ kbd)
components.note: ambiguous TYPE-02: allows text-xs for non-essential footer text (486) but bans it for instructions (493); keyboard-shortcut footer at text-xs subtle, kbd chips text-xs mono.

components.name: callsign-list
components.note: CSS multi-column list (18ch columns, base-300 hover); the guide lists the file only (3958).

components.name: empty-state
components.note: The ui_empty_state box: dashed border, text-base muted, as TYPE-03 requires for empty states (518). Box styling itself is not described in the guide.

components.name: form-fieldset / form-legend
components.note: Same block as the bare form fieldset rule: a primary/5 gradient and primary left rule on a grouping box, where gradients are for progress components only (757-760).

components.name: .input.has-icon / .select.has-icon
components.note: 2.5rem start padding for a leading icon in daisyUI inputs; undocumented.

components.name: .select::picker(select)
components.note: Customizable-select listing min-inline-size 0; undocumented.

components.name: sticky-progress-container
components.note: Guide: a new component gets no shadow (610). The sticky VC action bar carries shadow-sm (plus transition-all 200ms); used once in vc/applications/_action_bar.

components.name: progress-container / progress-bar / progress-bar-pulse / progress-labels-container
components.note: Guide: one neutral utility per purpose (983). Labels use text-sm text-base-content/60, off the ladder. Bar gradient and pulse match 724 and 733; the 500ms width transition has no reduced-motion rule.

components.name: progress-projected
components.note: Striped mask for an estimated bar; #000 is mask alpha, not a painted colour.

components.name: camera-preview / camera-video / camera-capture-btn / camera-select
components.note: Guide: buttons come from ButtonHelper, colour from the variant (1071, 1101). camera-capture-btn hand-styles a round bg-primary button with shadow and active:scale-95; camera-select is a hand-rolled select, not daisyUI select (FORM-01).

components.name: ui-label-value
components.note: Guide: write the lg fold through theme(--breakpoint-lg) (2924-2925). @media (width >= 1024px) literal. Label/value displays otherwise have no rule.

components.name: stat-meter / stat-meter-segment
components.note: Stacked segment bar on a base-200 track; a chart-like meter the guide does not describe (PROG-01 covers ui_progress_bar only).

components.name: vc-progress-item + -success/-danger/-warning/-pending/-neutral
components.note: Guide: text-xs never for labels or content a reader needs (489-494). Section-jump status pills label at text-xs; neutral uses text-base-content/60 off the ladder. min-h-9 matches TOUCH-01.

components.name: vc-check-chip / vc-stage / vc-stage-summary / vc-stage-chevron / vc-stage-body
components.note: VC guided-review stage cards (details/summary with box box-default), min-h-9 summary, rotating chevron; undocumented.

components.name: signup-sheet (+ signup-* cell classes)
components.note: Print sheet: #fff/#111 ink, pt sizes, inch widths, screen paper preview; print sheets as components have no rule.

components.name: trainers-report (+ report-* classes)
components.note: Print sheet at 9pt with masthead, stat tiles, chips, legend; 18 hex literals.

components.name: shift-lead-sheet (+ sheet-* classes)
components.note: Print sheet at 7.5pt (7pt doc label), fixed inch column widths, hex chips; the smallest print type in the set.

components.name: alpha-sheet (+ alpha-* classes)
components.note: Three alpha print sheets and the pod sheet at 11pt, write-in rows, forced 8pt badges; hex literals.

components.name: acceptance-sheet (+ acceptance-* classes)
components.note: Acceptance print form with page breaks, logo masthead, headshot box, red #a3000c alert text.

components.name: roster-col-select / roster-col-callsign / roster-frozen-cell / roster-frozen-heading / roster-grid-pane / roster-grid
components.note: Frozen first two columns (z-10/z-30), 70vh scroll pane, print unfreeze; a matrix of the kind TABLE-02 lets opt out of responsive.

components.name: shift-coverage-grid / shift-coverage-period
components.note: Sticky period column from lg only (z-10), column borders; undocumented.

components.name: top-hour-earners-grid / top-hour-earners-person
components.note: Sticky person column at every width (z-0); the page is TABLE-02's cited responsive:false example (1514) but the CSS is undocumented.

components.name: hours-credits-callsign / hours-credits-pane / hours-credits-grid / hours-credits-group
components.note: Frozen callsign column, 70vh pane, group borders, print-exact header; fourth frozen-column variant.

components.name: sandman-qualified-pane
components.note: 70vh scroll pane from lg with base-200 header cells; third copy of the bounded pane.

components.name: hq-gantt (+ -chart, -lane, -mark, -fill, -hit, -bar, -bar-text(-long), -swatch, -vacant, -gap)
components.note: HQ forecast Gantt chart: token hatches for vacant/gap, 2.25rem hit area, focus ring, forced-colors outlines, container queries; charts have no rule.

components.name: hq-forecast-pane / hq-forecast-table
components.note: From lg, header cells stick to the page (z-20, top -0.75rem); undocumented.

components.name: .hq-gantt-mark > .tooltip-content
components.note: daisyUI tooltip capped at 14rem and shown only on hover or focus; tooltips have no rule.

components.name: hq-shell / hq-shell-content / hq-summary
components.note: Guide: md is not for layout tiers (2949-2950). hq-window.css:37 lays the HQ summary out as a flex row with a dl grid only between md and lg. The 1800px/2400px zoom tier and 64rem/68ch caps match BP-03.

components.name: messages-workspace
components.note: Container query stacking the mailbox pane under the list below 50rem inside the HQ shell; content-driven adaptation the guide prefers (2929) but does not name.

components.name: photo-board (+ ~30 photo-board-* classes)
components.note: ROC wall display: text-3xl headings, success-coloured active group and rail, 0.3s colour/shadow transitions without a reduced-motion rule, 100vh bottom padding; undocumented.

components.name: lexxy-editor
components.note: Editor re-themed in tokens, text-base, primary focus ring with base-100 offset, as 2548-2551 describes.

components.name: lexxy-editor p.provisional-paragraph.hidden
components.note: !important display:block to keep Lexxy's caret paragraph usable against Tailwind's .hidden.

components.name: lexxy-highlight-dropdown, lexxy-code-language-picker
components.note: Hides the coloured-text and code-language tools; 2552 says coloured text is off.

components.name: lexxy-content
components.note: Saved rich text wraps, headings text-xl/lg/base semibold heading ink, lists on ps-list-indent (567, 2554).

components.name: bookmark-page
components.note: Kiosk bookmark page: links get padding-block 0.5rem and 0.75rem margins for reach instead of min-h-9; whether that reaches 36px needs a rendered page.

components.name: ct (+ ct-s0..s8, ct-swatch, ct-tick, ct-seg, ct-layer, ct-axis-day, ct-axis-month)
components.note: Credit timeline stacked-area chart in CSS with a hex series palette; charts have no rule.

components.name: disclosure-card
components.note: Print-only hook hiding a closed ui_disclosure card that holds an instruction-list.

components.name: review-pane
components.note: From lg the pane is capped and scrolls inside itself, as 3545-3547 describes; reads --zoom for the HQ tier.

components.name: review-line / review-line-flagged
components.note: Selected line keyed on aria-current (primary/10 + start rule), flagged line tinted red unless selected, as 3546 and 3557-3558 state.

components.name: driver-popover (+ title, description, progress-text, arrow sides, footer-btn, navigation-btns, close-btn)
components.note: bg-base-100, text-body, border-line, rounded-box, title text-lg heading ink, 36px close with the app focus ring: matches 2371-2379. shadow-lg fits popovers.

components.name: .tabs-lift > .tab / .tabs-border > .tab
components.note: daisyUI tab overrides: idle labels muted, lifted active tab heading ink with a 2px primary top border; the guide shows tabs-border markup but not these colours.

components.name: [data-theme="dark"] .badge-soft.badge-secondary
components.note: The dark soft-secondary contrast patch that 884-885 says badges.css holds.

components.name: [data-theme="dark"] .badge-soft.badge-error
components.note: The dark soft-error contrast patch named at 884-885; literal oklch(70% 0.18 28.536) in a component file.

components.name: .badge :is(.icon-*)
components.note: A status icon inside a badge inherits the badge colour; undocumented. Its comment (35-38) still says icons.css uses raw amber/red ramps, which it no longer does.

components.name: login-panel
components.note: Guide: colour never decoration; non-semantic amber is three documented legacy pieces, not to extend (153, 178, 180-188). The panel adds an amber gradient frame, radial amber wash and warm glow; also sm: padding outside field widths (BP-01).

components.name: login-title / login-tagline
components.note: Title at 1.625rem bold, off the type-scale table (471-473); tagline in text-body-subtle, which 957 lists as valid. Login typography is undocumented.

components.name: login-beta / login-beta-summary / login-beta-body
components.note: unused: amber-tinted disclosure card for a beta notice; no reference in views, helpers or JS.

components.name: login-backdrop
components.note: Guide: no coloured decoration (153, 178). A page-sized Rangers logo mask filled with warning at 20% sits behind the sign-in door, decoration in the status colour.

components.name: login-status
components.note: ambiguous COLOR-03: the playa-time line sets its <strong> in text-warning; the code does not show whether that marks a status or is emphasis.

components.name: login-field / login-label-row / login-label-link
components.note: Guide: form labels are text-base, never text-sm (469, 516). Login labels and the forgot-password link are 0.8125rem, below text-sm. The required asterisk is hidden too (FORM-03 asks for it).

components.name: login-reveal
components.note: Show-password button positioned inside the field, body-subtle ink, 36px from btn-square per comment.

components.name: login-input / login-input--reveal
components.note: 52px input with 0.625rem radius, inset shadow, amber caret and amber focus ring replacing daisyUI's outline, autofill repaint; undocumented.

components.name: login-submit-button
components.note: Guide: no hand-applied colour on a button, colour and hover come from the variant (1101-1103). Layers a warning gradient face, warm shadow, brightness hover and a 1px press translate over the helper's variant.

components.name: login-columns / login-column
components.note: Sign-in page grid, one column, 28rem + 1fr from lg with a 58rem cap; uses theme(--breakpoint-lg).

components.name: login-foot
components.note: unused: mt-6 text-center footer.

components.name: login-doors / -doors-title / -doors-lede / -doors-list / -door-lead
components.note: Guide: no coloured decoration, links in primary (153, 157). Amber top edge, amber wash and amber links and icons; lede at 0.8125rem and descriptions at 0.85rem sit below text-base (TYPE-03).

components.name: login reduced motion
components.note: Every transition and animation inside .login-panel is cut under prefers-reduced-motion, the login exception's condition (3225).

components.name: button_row
components.note: Sticky row, spacer and --button-row-controls match guide 2844-2889. The sticky shadow is an arbitrary rgba value with a dark: twin in helper markup (line 63); guide 1013-1014 keeps dark: pairs on raw values to component CSS.

components.name: button_action
components.note: Variant map, sm default and btn-disabled match guide 1101-1155. Undocumented: an unknown variant falls back to btn-primary, and nothing stops an icon-only call with no aria-label.

components.name: button_link
components.note: Same maps as button_action; disabled drops the href and adds btn-disabled + aria-disabled as guide 1185-1186 says. Unknown options (icon_position) leak to link_to as HTML attributes.

components.name: cancel_button (alias cancel_link)
components.note: Secondary button_link labelled Cancel, alias cancel_link, as guide 1128 documents.

components.name: edit_link
components.note: Secondary + solid pen-to-square, label Edit, matching guide 1129 ("the one edit control").

components.name: export_csv_link
components.note: The guide never names export_csv_link; its own examples (3401, 3450) spell button_link "Export CSV", :secondary by hand. Code: secondary, solid file-csv, variant: overridable.

components.name: delete_button
components.note: Guide 1130 says delete_button "includes confirmation". Code confirms only when confirm_message: or confirm_modal: is passed; a bare delete_button url deletes on click. Both confirm paths do use variant :error.

components.name: submit_button
components.note: Guide shows submit_button "Save"; COPY-04 bans "Submit". The default label is "Submit" (line 241). Otherwise a btn-primary btn-sm input as documented; no icon support.

components.name: button_classes
components.note: Private class-string builder used for summary/span elements styled as buttons; guide 934 says use ButtonHelper methods rather than the classes and does not document this.

components.name: ui_table
components.note: full_width false, striped true, responsive true, caption sr-only match guide 1419-1424. Undocumented size: "sm" option emits text-sm table content, which TABLE-03 forbids when used.

components.name: ui_table builder: header / heading / body / row / row_header / cell
components.note: right:/center:/width: as guide 1426-1481 shows (width as inline style is the documented form). row state: and align: are undocumented; state tints use !important.

components.name: ui_table builder: detail_row
components.note: Hidden full-span detail row with mobile-only label; not in the guide.

components.name: ui_table builder: detail_row_toggle
components.note: Ghost btn-sm with min-h-9 h-auto, aria-controls/expanded and a label-in-name accessible name; not in the guide.

components.name: ui_table_rows
components.note: Rows-only builder for turbo_stream replacement; not in the guide.

components.name: modal
components.note: API matches guide 1588-1603 (title/body/footer, modal controller). The dialog carries no aria-labelledby to its h3 or aria-modal, and modal_controller.js adds none, so it has no accessible name. Confirm in a rendered page.

components.name: ModalBuilder title / body / footer / close_button
components.note: TYPE-04: h3 takes heading-title. The title h3 is modal-title-text (text-xl, modals.css), and the guide sample (808) shows text-lg. Close icon button is btn-circle, not btn-square (TOUCH-02).

components.name: modal_dialog
components.note: Turbo-frame modal scaffold with title and body, no auto footer; not in the guide.

components.name: modal_form_footer
components.note: button_row of submit plus modal_close_button Cancel; not in the guide, though it follows BTN-07.

components.name: modal_close_dialog
components.note: Turbo stream that empties the modal frame; no markup.

components.name: modal_close_button
components.note: Secondary button_action with modal#hide, used as guide 1597 shows.

components.name: confirm_modal
components.note: Returns turbo_confirm dialog data and passes variant: through, the form guide 3827 names for a red destructive confirm.

components.name: confirm_modal_dialog
components.note: MODAL-02: ask with the action and say whether it can be undone. Defaults are title "Confirm", message "Continue?", confirm variant :primary; a caller that omits them gets a generic question.

components.name: modal_placement_class
components.note: Internal placement map (modal-top/bottom/middle).

components.name: tab_navigation
components.note: tabs tabs-border, role tab/tabpanel, aria-selected, remote href panes as guide 1661-1674. Every tablist is named the generic "Tabs"; options[:remote] is never read.

components.name: fa_icon
components.note: Regular default, raise on missing regular glyph (guide 3113-3116), size:/start:/end: per 3137-3145, aria-hidden, label: sr-only text. size: builds "fa-#{size}" by interpolation.

components.name: nav_link_to
components.note: Active-state link helper with aria-current; not in the guide and has zero callers.

components.name: callsign_link
components.note: TABLE_LINK_CLASSES min-h-5 is the one standing exception guide 581 names, and the constant carries its comment.

components.name: email_link_or_dash
components.note: mailto link with TABLE_LINK_CLASSES, or "—" when no address.

components.name: person_display_name
components.note: Callsign, "—" by default when no id, or "Deleted #id".

components.name: person_display_link

components.name: mega_item_link_options

components.name: sidebar_section
components.note: h6.sidebar-section-header with theme classes, as the guide structure at 2063 shows.

components.name: sidebar_submenu

components.name: sidebar_item
components.note: Guide 2143-2153 lists icon:, icon_type:, badge:, badge_variant:. Code accepts all four and renders none (render_sidebar_content has no caller). active/active_prefix/use_turbo/aria-current match.

components.name: sidebar_submenu_item
components.note: li wrapping sidebar_item with pl-4, as guide 2027 shows; zero callers.

components.name: years_breakdown
components.note: Undocumented; its partial (common/_years_breakdown.html.erb:17,34) prints empty values as italic muted "none" rather than "—", and hand-writes dl.ui-label-value with a class on only the first dt.

components.name: year_range

components.name: dropdown_scroll_list
components.note: Guide 3303 says the letter links are plain fragments with data-turbo="false". The partial's dropdown_item links carry no data-turbo and rely on application.js turbo:click to scroll instead.

components.name: none_stated
components.note: EMPTY-02: an empty value prints "—". This prints italic muted "None stated".

components.name: value_or_dash

components.name: record_title

components.name: value_list

components.name: expires_on_cell / expires_at_cell

components.name: photo_tag
components.note: STYLE-01: no inline style=. width:/height: become an inline px style (lines 148-149). Missing photo falls back to an unlabelled user icon.

components.name: hyperlink_text / nl2br / rich_text
components.note: rich_text sanitizes and keeps lexxy-content__ classes as guide 2539-2555 expects; the .lexxy-content wrapper is the caller's. hyperlink_text/nl2br are plain-text formatting with no rule.

components.name: hour_not_counted_disclaimer

components.name: slot_virtual_venue_badge
components.note: ui_badge :secondary with laptop icon.

components.name: back_to
components.note: Guide 3074-3075: text link with left arrow, muted colour with hover state. Code rests at text-body and hovers to text-stone-emphasis, the same --color-body token (guide 955), so no muted rest and no visible hover.

components.name: back_to_dashboard
components.note: back_to "Clubhouse Dashboard"; hero_panel back_to: :dashboard routes here.

components.name: yes_no_badge
components.note: ui_badge with text and icon, not colour alone.

components.name: qualification_icon / ... / qualification_unit
components.note: COLOR-05: a status icon takes icon-success/warning/error/info. The "on track" hourglass is text-primary (line 287); none of the four state icons has a label:.

components.name: setting / phone_format / title_marking_inactive / position_choices_by_team
components.note: Value helpers, no markup.

components.name: action_box
components.note: Undocumented card. TYPE-03 bans text-sm for primary card information; the description is text-sm. The icon is always icon-warning (COLOR-05), and icon_position: :end is not a ButtonHelper option.

components.name: ui_badge
components.note: badge badge-{v} badge-soft text-{size}, xs default, icon_type :solid, class:/aria: as guide 883-895 and 1980-2006. :info falls back to secondary colours.

components.name: bulk_select

components.name: bulk_select_all
components.note: Select-all checkbox in a min-h-9 min-w-9 label, optional visible label and live count.
