components.name: filter_bar
components.note: Filters toggle with count badge, GET-link chips, clear-all, count and actions: slot as guide 1561-1580. Chips are hand-rolled rounded-full links (text-sm).

components.name: filter_chips / active_filters / known_filter / filter_time / ... / filter_url
components.note: Data helpers for chips, option lists and URLs; no markup.

components.name: ui_flash_successful / ui_flash_submit_error / ui_success_text
components.note: "{thing} {verb}." success wording and an error flash set from the controller, as guide 1682-1695 asks.

components.name: ui_callout_box
components.note: Five variants, title:, accent:, icon:/icon_type: as guide 1723-1745. Undocumented: role="alert" by default on every type, info and success included.

components.name: ui_alert_banner
components.note: label + type as guide 1749-1753. Checks for :danger, which BOX_TYPES lacks, and an unknown type takes success styling.

components.name: ui_empty_state
components.note: Message or block, icon: with :regular default, class: appended, as guide 2310-2324.

components.name: ui_toast_render / ui_toast_stream
components.note: Durations and roles by type match guide 1700-1704 (success/notice/info status, warning alert, error/alert stay).

components.name: ui_accent_card
components.note: API, variants and heading_level match guide 1257-1289. SHADOW-01: hover is a colour change, never a lift; the card adds transition-all hover:shadow-sm on a non-interactive article. info border is full opacity, others /30.

components.name: ui_accordion
components.note: details.collapse collapse-arrow with unstyled: escape, as guide 1607-1619. Summary is text-sm font-semibold.

components.name: ui_card
components.note: CARD-01 / guide 711-713: card-standard has no shadow and a card that needs one adds shadow-xs at the call site. ui_card defaults shadow: :xs, so every card gets one. width:/height: inline style as documented (1214).

components.name: ui_card_image
components.note: Not in the guide. width:/height: are computed into options that never reach image_tag, and class: is ignored.

components.name: ui_card_body
components.note: div.text-body.px-4, used as the guide sample at 1199 shows.

components.name: ui_card_title
components.note: size: :lg default as guide 1198 uses. Renders a centred div, not a heading, so it never enters the outline.

components.name: ui_card_section
components.note: TYPE-05: clear h1 > h2 > h3 hierarchy. The section title is always an h6 whatever the surrounding level.

components.name: ui_card_footer
components.note: Centred flex footer, as the guide sample at 1205 uses.

components.name: ui_data_block
components.note: Not in the guide. Pre block in font-mono text-sm, border-base-300 (other boxes use border-line), shadow-inner.

components.name: ui_disclosure
components.note: :inline keeps the native marker; :card has title, subtitle and rotating chevron, as guide 1611-1612. The card title is font-semibold only for plain strings.

components.name: ui_drill_down_row
components.note: Row with meta: and badges: as the records-management level-1 sample uses (3414-3418). Undocumented figures: and blocked:; header comment says chevron, default icon is arrow-right.

components.name: ui_form
components.note: form_with builder: AppFormBuilder plus the error summary, as guide 2408-2424.

components.note: icon required, heading_level :h1/:h2 default :h2 at text-2xl/text-xl, back link right on desktop and above on mobile, compact/full year selector (1818-1831, 3050-3075). Title icon always icon-warning.

components.name: hero_panel builder: hero_stats / stat_badge
components.note: Documented with approval required (1830-1847); :default and :warning colours as the sample. The list is named "{id} statistics", which reads "hero-panel-xxxx statistics" with an auto id.

components.name: hero_panel builder: progress / progress_status / year_selector / back_to / description / title
components.note: Panel methods as guide 1824-1831 and 1895-1896; the year selector renders compact on desktop and full on mobile.

components.name: ui_icon_item
components.note: li with leading icon and tone: class; not in the guide.

components.name: ui_label_value
components.note: Undocumented. TYPE-03 bans text-sm for labels and primary content; the default size: :sm sets the whole label/value list in text-sm. label_width travels as an inline style property.

components.name: ui_match_stepper
components.note: join group named by label:, role=status count, secondary btn-square icon buttons named Previous match/Next match, as guide 1631-1655.

components.name: ui_pager
components.note: Pagination has no rule. Summary line plus Previous Page/Next Page secondary buttons, disabled at the ends; no nav landmark.

components.name: ui_progress_bar
components.note: Variants, sizes and label: match guide 1902-1917. The fill width is an inline style="width: N%" (line 106), a computed number.

components.name: ui_progress_box
components.note: COLOR-01 bans palette colours and dark: pairs in markup. ICON_BADGE_BASE uses from-amber-100 to-orange-100 dark:from-amber-900/40 (line 21); guide 736-743 records it as tolerated legacy.

components.name: render_progress_bar
components.note: Gradient fill and pulse classes as guide 721-733. Fill and pulse widths are inline styles (lines 32, 40); a 5% floor is what aria-valuenow reports at 0.

components.name: render_progress_status
components.note: Guide 1896 names progress_status but gives nothing to compare. Polite atomic status div.

components.name: progress_count_of
components.note: "X of Y label" with font-medium emphasis; not in the guide.

components.note: Guide 1964/1971: border: false removes the body padding. Code always keeps px-4 pb-2 and border: false drops only a second px-4 pb-1. Guide title padding px-4 py-2; code px-4 pt-2 mb-1.

components.note: div role=heading aria-level=2 with heading-section; not in the guide.

components.name: ui_subheading
components.note: h3.heading-title; not in the guide, though its markup follows TYPE-04.

components.name: ui_stat_box

components.name: ui_stat_link
components.note: Stat box wrapped in a focus-ringed link with aria-label and an active ring; not in the guide.

components.name: ui_stat_row
components.note: Wrapping flex row, gap-2 lg:gap-4, as guide 1364-1366.

components.name: UiComponentsHelper (module)
components.note: Module that includes 13 of 26 UiComponents modules; no markup.

components.name: AppFormBuilder (class)
components.note: The builder the guide names (2390); layout :vertical/:horizontal/:auto and per-field layout: as documented at 2426-2453; an unknown layout falls back to :vertical silently (177-181), which the guide does not mention.

components.name: AppFormBuilder class constants (field skin)
components.note: daisyUI input/select/textarea/file-input with their *-error modifiers, as 2680 says; labels text-base font-medium and help text-sm font-normal match the Typography Quick Reference (4028-4038); semantic tokens only (COLOR-01).

components.name: layout :vertical (build_vertical_field)
components.note: Visible <label for> above the field, wrapper mb-3 and label mb-1 exactly as 2397 and SPACE-01 state; error or help line follows the field.

components.name: layout :horizontal (build_horizontal_field)
components.note: Guide sets form field spacing at mb-3 (2397, SPACE-01); the horizontal wrapper has no bottom margin, so stacked horizontal fields touch unless the caller spaces them. Error label also drops lg:mr-2 (119), shifting the column on error.

components.name: layout :auto (build_auto_field)
components.note: Documented auto layout (2439): vertical below lg, label column from lg, mb-3 wrapper. Label column lg:w-1/8 versus horizontal lg:w-1/4 is not specified by the guide.

components.name: text_field, email_field, password_field, number_field, url_field, telephone_field, search_field, date_field, time_field, color_field
components.note: Field types and the model-derived maxlength match 2472-2491; default w-auto with width: substitution is the documented width option. date_field/time_field are native pickers; guide comment at 2498 is ambiguous on whether they get Vanilla Calendar.

components.name: datetime_field (date/time picker)
components.note: Vanilla Calendar Pro as 2498 documents, selectionTimeMode 24 keeps the 24-hour clock COPY-08 requires. The value format the calendar writes is set in JS, not traced.

components.name: autocomplete_field
components.note: Uses ac-results and ac-loading (ac-loading is not in the 2349-2358 list); label for the visible input, describedby/invalid/required propagated; placeholder "Search…" with the single-character ellipsis (COPY-07). Loading state is text only, no spinner.

components.name: callsign_chips_field
components.note: Guide (2571) says the input's aria-label is "Add a callsign"; the field passes aria_label: nil (_callsign_chips.html.erb:15) so the visible label names it instead. Code is defensible; guide text is stale.

components.name: text_area
components.note: Guide comment (2503) promises a 120px minimum height; the field is "textarea w-full resize-y" and daisyUI 5's textarea sets min-height 5rem (80px). No CSS in components/ raises it. Default w-full is also wider than the width table suggests.

components.name: rich_text_area
components.note: Lexxy editor with label targeting it, error state "border-error border-2" exactly as 2551-2552 documents; lost-images warning is a ui_callout_box :warning leading with a bold key point (COPY-10).

components.name: select, collection_select
components.note: Signatures, label:/width: in options or html_options, and select/select-error classes match 2512-2514 and 2680.

components.name: check_box
components.note: Guide: required: shows the marker and adds the required attribute for all fields (2462). check_box consumes required: and renders neither. Also, in horizontal/auto layout label: becomes an unassociated <span> (881-883, 906-908), leaving the box unnamed without inline_label (FORM-02, high).

components.name: radio_button
components.note: Guide: the 36px class goes on the wrapping <label> of a checkbox or radio (579). The radio sits outside its label; the label has min-h-9 but the radio-sm itself is about 20px. required: is also dropped (FORM-03).

components.name: collection_radio_buttons
components.note: Guide: radio groups get a fieldset with legend (2403, 2589). Vertical and :stacked do; horizontal/auto inline name the group with a plain <span>, so the group has no accessible name. Items repeat the radio-outside-label TOUCH-01 gap; sm:columns-2 breaks BP-01.

components.name: file_field
components.note: daisyUI file-input (the "styled upload button" of 2525) with file-input-error, in the standard labelled wrapper.

components.name: fieldset
components.note: f.fieldset "Legend", icon:, icon_type: as 2597-2614; form-legend is text-lg font-semibold per the Quick Reference. Default icon_type :regular while field icons default :solid; guide examples always pass :solid.

components.name: submit
components.note: f.submit as in 2414-2417 and 2849-2852, classes from ButtonHelper#button_classes (btn btn-primary btn-sm), so 36px and variant colours come from the helper. Emits <input type=submit>, so no icon is possible.

components.name: required marker (required_marker, private)
components.note: Guide: red asterisk plus screen-reader text "(required)" (2400, 2710). Default prints visible "(required)" in text-xs (TYPE-02 bans text-xs on labels); required_label: "" prints an asterisk with no text alternative. Neither variant matches.

components.name: help text (help_text_tag, public)
components.note: Guide: help text tied by aria-describedby (2711), help_mode :tooltip documented (2464). Inline mode complies (text-sm text-body). Tooltip mode puts help only in a title on an unfocusable span while aria-describedby names a "_hint" id that is never rendered.

components.name: inline field error (error_message, public)
components.note: input-error on the field, red label, role="alert" message under it with a red circle-exclamation icon (the 2681 "badge"), aria-invalid and describedby; text-sm font-medium allowed by TYPE-03. Messages join with a space as 3843 requires.

components.name: character counter (show_counter)
components.note: show_counter: documented at 2473/2488; counter text "text-sm ms-2 text-body" is supporting text, which text-sm allows. The counter element is drawn by the input-counter controller (JS not traced).

components.name: icon prefix (wrap_with_icon, private)
components.note: Field icon:/icon_type:/icon_class: options are not in the Field Options table (2457-2473). Icon is aria-hidden, neutral text-stone-muted (red on error), positioned with physical left-0 pl-3; input gets has-icon padding.

components.name: replace_class option
components.note: replace_class: true drops the whole daisyUI skin including the error variant and uses the caller's class: alone; not documented in the guide.

components.name: form_row
components.note: Documented side-by-side wrapper (2448-2452, 2655): flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-3 mb-1, lg fold per BP-01. Gap-3 differs from the conditional-field pattern's gap-2 lg:gap-4 (2820) but no rule sets it.

components.name: form_error_summary
components.note: Guide: a bulleted list is list-bulleted (556-568). The summary's <ul class="mt-2 space-y-1"> draws its own bullets with an • span per item. Otherwise COMPLIANT FORM-06: ui_callout_box :error at the top, role=alert, focusable id.

components.name: input_counter_data
components.note: Documented use data: input_counter_data (2510); same text-sm text-body counter style as show_counter.

components.name: ui_form
components.note: form_with builder: AppFormBuilder, summary before the form, no_error_summary: opt-out, and data-controller="form" for first-error focus, all as 2405-2423 and 2684-2703. Focus behaviour itself lives in JS, not traced.

components.name: filter_bar
components.note: Matches 1559-1582: Filters toggle with count badge, removable chips, clear-all, result count, actions: at the far end, collapsed GET-form panel. Panel uses rounded-base (RADIUS-01 reserves it for buttons/inputs; rounded-lg for panels); count is text-lg.

components.name: filter_bar chip (filter_bar_chip, private)
components.note: The documented "removable chip" (1565): rounded-full pill, min-h-9, text-sm (pills allowed by TYPE-03), hover is a colour change, aria-label "Remove filter: …". Hand-built classes rather than a daisyUI badge; duration-200 not the 150ms of 2401.

components.name: filter_chips
components.note: Data helper building [{label: "<Label>: <value>", url:}] for filter_bar chips; no markup.

components.name: active_filters, known_filter, filter_time, filter_status_options, filter_select_options, filter_signed_up_options, filter_url
components.note: Data helpers; filter_status_options prints each status as stored ("<status> (<count>)", no titleize) as 3714-3731 requires. "All" first in every select.

components.name: bulk_select
components.note: Bulk selection has no rule: a div scope carrying data-controller="checkbox-select-all".

components.name: bulk_select_all
components.note: Bulk selection has no rule. check_box_tag with the builder's CHECKBOX_CLASSES inside a min-h-9 min-w-9 label (header cell) or a min-h-9 labelled bar with live count; meets the 36px floor.

components.name: bulk_select_count
components.note: Bulk selection has no rule: "N selected" span, text-stone-muted, aria-live polite, updated by the controller.

components.name: position_picker_count_label
components.note: Plain string "N of M selected" for the position picker; no markup.

components.name: bulk_select_checkbox
components.note: Bulk selection has no rule. Row checkbox (CHECKBOX_CLASSES) wrapped in a min-h-9 min-w-9 label, accessible name only from aria_label: (nameless if the caller omits it).

components.name: common/_form_wrapper (partial)
components.note: Guide: forms get ui_form's summary and automatic first-error focus via the form controller (2684-2703). This partial is form_with + AppFormBuilder without the form controller and with its own summary inside the form. No callers found, hence low.

components.name: common/_error_summary (partial)
components.note: Guide: the error summary is ui_form's (2684), i.e. form_error_summary. This second summary differs in wording ("The following errors were found:"), weight, and lacks the id/tabindex focus target. Rendered only by the uncalled _form_wrapper.

components.name: shared/_autocomplete (partial)
components.note: Guide: ellipsis is "…", placeholders included (3850). Default placeholder is "Search..." (line 1). Otherwise AC-01 compliant (ac-loading, ac-results, ac-keyboard-help); default input class carries both w-auto and w-full.

components.name: shared/_callsign_chips (partial)
components.note: Owner-approved chips box (2560-2577); input min-h-9 inside the input-skinned box, label names the input via field_id. aria_label: nil departs from the guide's stated aria-label (see callsign_chips_field line).

components.name: shared/_callsign_chip (partial)
components.note: Chip classes rounded-full border border-line bg-base-200 text-sm text-body exactly as 2576; remove control is button_action ghost btn-square (36px) labelled "Remove <callsign>" as 2572 states.

components.name: agreement_status, agreement_border_class, agreement_bg_class
components.note: Guide: a left-border accent card is ui_accent_card with a status variant (1216-1296). These hashes feed hand-built accent cards (comment line 4 says so); not_available uses border-l-secondary while the others are non-directional /30 tints.

components.name: agreement_badge
components.note: ui_badge with success/warning/secondary variants, size sm, and an aria-label stating the status in words (A11Y-01). Badge text is lower case ("available to sign"); badges are not in COPY-03's Title Case list.

components.name: agreement_icon
components.note: Guide: icons are neutral (text-stone-muted/text-stone-icon) or a status icon-* class (635-637). Signed and pending use icon-success/icon-warning; not_available uses text-secondary, neither neutral nor a status icon class.

components.name: AuthorizeHelper (authorize_role, authorize_status, deny_status, authorize_ability, require_current_year_for, can?)
components.note: Controller authorization concern; emits no markup.

components.name: BasicCacheHelper (cache_exist?, cache_read, cache_write, cache_delete)
components.note: Rails.cache wrappers; no markup.

components.name: CountryStateHelper (country_has_states?, is_canada?, is_usa?, state_data_json, country_form_data_attributes, country_data_attributes, state_data_attributes)
components.note: Option constants and data attributes for the country-state controller; select placeholder "Choose Country". No rule covers select placeholder wording.

components.name: credit_format
components.note: Credit count formatting: "zero credits", "1 credit", "2.50 credits" (two decimals). COPY-09 covers prices only.

components.name: credit_format_short
components.note: Number-only credits "0" or "2.50"; comment says it serves hero stats badges, which STAT-02 would bar outside /me (caller not checked here).

components.name: datetime_format
components.note: "Thu Jan 8 @ 14:30" and "Thu Jan 8, 2026 @ 14:30" exactly as the 3860-3872 table; unpadded day, year before time, 24-hour. Range forms are not in the table but follow its rules.

components.name: slot_shift_time
components.note: Delegates to datetime_format with the slot's zone and abbreviation; same table formats plus " (PDT)".

components.name: zoned_datetime_format
components.note: "Thu Jan 8, 2026 @ 13:30 (PT)": table format for date and time with year. Year defaults on even for the current year, where the table uses the year only "in another year".

components.name: pacific_datetime_format
components.note: zoned_datetime_format in America/Los_Angeles, labelled (PT); same format and the same year-default caveat.

components.name: log_time_format
components.note: "2026-01-08 14:30:00" matches the table's admin-log format.

components.name: full_datetime_format
components.note: "Thursday, January 8, 2026 @ 14:30": table's long form plus time, year before time, 24-hour. Unparseable input prints "invalid date [x]" to readers, which no rule covers.

components.name: hour_minute_format
components.note: Duration as clock digits "5:07" (hours unpadded); the COPY-08 table covers dates and times of day, not durations.

components.name: hour_minute_words
components.note: Duration in words "2 hours 5 mins" (abbreviated "mins"), full: "2 hours and 5 minutes"; no duration rule.

components.name: hour_format
components.note: Decimal hours "2.50"; no duration rule.

components.name: day_hour_format
components.note: Duration "12 days 7 hours" (pluralized, "1 day 0 hours"); no duration rule.

components.name: hour_minute_or_day_format, hour_minute_words_or_day_format
components.note: Switches at one day between clock/words and days-hours; no duration rule.

components.name: month_day_format
components.note: "January 8" matches the table's running-copy format.

components.name: wday_month_day_format
components.note: "Thu Jan 8" (and ", 2026" with year:) matches the table's day label.

components.name: short_datetime_format
components.note: "Wed 9/2 17:29" matches the table's chip-with-no-room format "Thu 1/8 14:30".

components.name: ymd_format
components.note: "2026-01-08" matches the table's date for admin logs, CSV and form field values.

components.name: mdy_format
components.note: "Jan 8, 2026" and full: "Thursday, January 8, 2026" match the table's Date and Long form.

components.name: DateTimeHelper format constants
components.note: Table (3871-3872): CSV timestamps "2026-01-08 14:30:00" and a chip "Thu 1/8 14:30". CSV_TIME drops the seconds ("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"); CHIP_TIME, used for filter-chip timestamps, is the ISO form, not SHORT_DAY_TIME. Other constants match.

components.name: event_date_window
components.note: ambiguous EMPTY-02: an unset window shows a ui_badge "Not set" (secondary, circle-minus icon) rather than "—"; the rule does not say whether a stated fact like "Not set" counts as an empty value.

components.name: gender_format
components.note: Guide: an empty value prints "—" (3853). A person with no gender identity, or custom with no text, prints "Not specified".

components.name: pronouns_format
components.note: ambiguous EMPTY-02: returns "" when no pronouns, which suits inline use after a name; whether a cell shows a blank or "—" depends on the caller.

components.name: has_role? (RolesHelper)
components.note: Role predicate with no markup; it never tests the role (returns Array.wrap(role), truthy for any signed-in user).

components.name: shirt_size_title, shirt_size_label
components.note: Unknown size flagged by colour plus icon (icon-warning circle-question) and the "Unknown" text; status icon uses the icon-* class COLOR-05 names.

components.name: shirt_select_options, shirt_build_options
components.note: Option arrays with a "Not Selected" placeholder; no rule covers select placeholder wording (compare "Choose Country", "All").

components.name: ext_link
components.note: Link helpers have no rule: target=_blank link with external-link icon (start: 2), hover:underline, no text or aria saying it opens a new tab; overwrites caller rel/target.

components.name: salesforce_record_url, append_query_params
components.note: URL-string helpers; no markup.

components.name: application.js: turbo confirm dialog
components.note: Shows ModalHelper#confirm_modal_dialog markup as a native <dialog>; only #turbo-confirm-button is yes, Escape is no. A plain-string data-turbo-confirm falls back to window.confirm (line 119), which is where view-level MODAL-02 departures surface.

components.name: application.js: dropdown auto-close
components.note: ambiguous NAV-01: rule names dropdown_menu/dropdown_item but not close-on-outside-click or close-on-link behaviour; no Escape handling, native <details> summary still toggles from the keyboard.

components.name: application.js: same-page anchors
components.note: Cancels turbo:click for same-page #fragment links so the browser scrolls instead of refetching; HELP-01 anchor links rely on it but the guide does not document the behaviour.

components.name: application.js: morph-skip class sync
components.note: Elements with data-morph-skip keep their DOM through morphs but take the server's classes (so input-error lands); guide does not document data-morph-skip.

components.name: application.js: turbo-frame missing / page_redirect
components.note: A frame answer without the frame becomes a full visit of that response; custom page_redirect stream action. No visible UI rule applies.

components.name: application.js: cache clean-up
components.note: Empties #live-region lines and resets the year selector forms before Turbo caches the page; not documented in the guide.

components.name: application.js: messages list scroll restore
components.note: Saves and restores .drawer-content scrollTop around /me/messages/N visits via sessionStorage; scroll restoration is not addressed by any rule.

components.name: application.js: analytics page_view
components.note: gtag page_view on turbo:load without the query string; no visible UI.

components.name: live_region.js announce()
components.note: Adds one line to #live-region (or the open dialog's [data-live-region]), as TOAST-03, TOAST-02 and TABLE-06 describe for screen-reader announcements.

components.name: scrolling.js
components.note: scrollBehavior() is smooth only when prefers-reduced-motion is not set; reveal() steps at once where asked, matching the tour (TOUR-01) and stepper (NAV-03) notes.

components.name: storage.js
components.note: Error-swallowing localStorage/sessionStorage wrapper; no UI.

components.name: requests.js readJson()
components.note: Turns a redirected JSON answer into a Turbo visit and an error answer into a thrown message that callers display; no rule on client-side request errors.

components.name: confirm_checkbox.js confirmChecked()
components.note: Guide: confirm through the app's dialog (confirm_modal), red when destructive. Code: native window.confirm, used by membership-editor and permission-editor for permission grants.

components.name: active-links
components.note: Guide (traps, 3582) says it restamps aria-current from an exact query match and skips links naming a frame other than _top; code does exactly that, plus data-active-ignore and data-active-prefix.

components.name: asset-form
components.note: Rewrites the two duration radio labels ("Shift"/"Event" or "Temporary"/"Permanent") when the asset type changes; label text swapped in JS is not addressed.

components.name: autocomplete
components.note: Guide: approved spinners must honour prefers-reduced-motion. Code: "Searching…" row builds an animate-spin icon with no reduced-motion override (none in accessibility.css or autocomplete.css). ac-* classes otherwise follow AC-01.

components.name: autofocus
components.note: Focuses the element on connect and puts the caret at the end; focus-on-load is not documented.

components.name: bookmark (extends kiosk)
components.note: Guide: times use a 24-hour clock. Code: toLocaleString with hour "2-digit" and no hourCycle, so an en-US browser shows a 12-hour clock with AM/PM on the kiosk page.

components.name: bulk-edit
components.note: Spreadsheet dirty-row tracking: view-supplied dirty classes (bg-warning/10) plus an unhidden marker, "N rows changed" count, Save/Discard disabled while clean. Bulk editing has no rule.

components.name: callsign-chips
components.note: Matches the Callsign Chips Field section: remove button labelled "Remove <callsign>", removing refocuses the input, Enter makes a chip not a submit, a press in the box focuses the text.

components.name: camera
components.note: Guide: everything works from the keyboard; tabs come from tab_navigation (TABS-01). Code: hand-rolled Upload/Camera tabs set tabIndex -1 on the idle tab with no arrow-key handler, so "Take Selfie" is unreachable by Tab.

components.name: checkbox-select-all
components.note: Header toggle for row checkboxes, "N selected" count written only on change, submit disabled while none checked. Bulk selection has no rule.

components.name: conditional-show
components.note: Guide shows its usage (Conditional Field Layout, 2822) without stating behaviour; toggles "hidden" on a field wrapper by select value, with no aria-expanded/aria-controls.

components.name: copy-to-clipboard
components.note: "Copied" tip for 2000ms inside the control, aria-hidden, popover where anchoring is supported, announced via #live-region, focus unchanged: as TOAST-03 documents. Failure is silent (empty catch, line 30).

components.name: country-state
components.note: Guide: an empty value prints "—". Code: the state select's blank option is "-" (lines 62, 80). Also dims the label with opacity-60 for a disabled field, which no rule covers.

components.name: dialog (base)
components.note: ambiguous MODAL-01: rule says modals open through the modal controller; this on-demand base (one modal at a time, backdrop click, hotkey, error callouts by kind) serves search and mega menu and is not documented.

components.name: disclosure-fields
components.note: Disables every field inside a closed <details> so folded choices are not sent; not documented.

components.name: download-confirm
components.note: Asks through Turbo.config.forms.confirm with confirm_modal_dialog markup (payroll_export_helper.rb:99), so the app's dialog is used, then starts the download.

components.name: dropdown-fit
components.note: ambiguous STYLE-01: rule bans a style= attribute in markup; this sets a computed px custom property (--dropdown-fit-shift) from JS to keep a dropdown_scroll_list panel inside the row.

components.name: form
components.note: Guide: the first error field receives focus automatically. Code: focuses #form-error-summary first and only falls back to the first errored field when no summary exists.

components.name: hq-shift (extends unsaved-changes)
components.note: Guide: confirms use the app dialog and ask "<Verb> <thing>?". Code: leave guards via window.confirm ("It looks like a shift was not started. Leave this page anyway?"). Also animate-pulse on a checklist chip (line 236), not a badge.

components.name: hq-wizard
components.note: ambiguous MODAL-01: a multi-step wizard in one native <dialog> opened with its own showModal and step machine, not the modal controller; the guide has no wizard pattern.

components.name: input-counter
components.note: ambiguous FORM-04: guide shows input_counter_data usage only; the "N of MAX characters" div is not tied to the field by aria-describedby and is not a live region.

components.name: kiosk (base)
components.note: Timed Turbo Frame reload with bare-seconds countdown and silent retry on failure; kiosk pages and loading states have no rule.

components.name: lexxy
components.note: Rich Text Area section says the label targets the editor; the controller focuses lexxy-editor on a label click and keeps its link box out of form validation.

components.name: link-options
components.note: Repoints a Turbo Frame src when the position select changes; no loading indicator. Loading states have no rule.

components.name: list-filter
components.note: Client-side row filter hiding rows and empty groups; unhides a server-rendered empty target only when a term matches nothing. The empty target's markup is the view's.

components.name: live-log
components.note: Server-pushed rows land in the table (cap 200) with an empty target and a "stalled" notice after 10s; nothing pops a toast, as TOAST-02 asks.

components.name: local-time
components.note: Tooltip restated in the browser zone with hourCycle h23 and a numeric day: 24-hour clock, no zero-padded day.

components.name: login-submit
components.note: Disables the session form's submit and sets its value to data-pending-label or "Working…"; busy states have no rule ("Working" here means processing, not volunteering, so COPY-01 does not apply).

components.name: mark-result
components.note: Writes one result into every ticked row's select and dispatches change; no visible feedback. Bulk selection has no rule.

components.name: mega-menu (extends dialog)
components.note: Navbar dialog: panels by hidden attribute with aria-current on chrome buttons (not aria-selected), client filter, Escape clears query first, focus management, error callouts by kind. Not documented beyond a mention at 2083.

components.name: membership-editor
components.note: Guide: confirm in the app dialog, asking with the action and saying if it can be undone. Code: multi-paragraph window.confirm texts ("Grant this position anyway?", "Make them a Clubhouse Manager anyway?") via confirm_checkbox.

components.name: message-search (extends callsign-chips)
components.note: Mailbox search field: a person suggestion becomes a chip and submits, removing a chip resubmits, a failed search resets field and chips from the URL. Not documented.

components.name: modal
components.note: Native <dialog> auto-shown on connect, closable=false blocks Escape, focus returned to autofocusOnCloseId, removed after close: the documented "data-controller=modal" opener.

components.name: onboarding
components.note: Matches TOUR-01: only on /me, animate false, Back/Next dressed btn btn-sm btn-ghost / btn-primary by the controller, smooth scroll off under reduced motion, overlay click inert.

components.name: passkey
components.note: Errors written into an inline error target as whole sentences ending in a period, in the reader's words; submit disabled while waiting.

components.name: password-reveal
components.note: Toggle button keeps its "Show password" name, sets aria-pressed, swaps the eye glyph and keeps focus on the button.

components.name: permission-editor
components.note: Guide: confirm in the app dialog with "<Verb> <thing>?" plus whether it can be undone. Code: native confirm() on submit, opening "WARNING: <titles> require prior approval…", and window.confirm on toggle (line 29).

components.name: photo-board (extends kiosk)
components.note: Wall display walks groups every 5s (smooth unless reduced motion), toggles active classes, sets --photo-board-header-height. Kiosk displays have no rule.

components.name: photo-cropper
components.note: Guide: inline notices are ui_callout_box. Code: window.alert for crop errors (238, 245, 251, 270), unlike photo-upload and passkey which unhide an inline error box; 238 and 245 also lack a period (COPY-06).

components.name: photo-upload
components.note: Guide: messages are whole sentences ending in a period. Code: "Please select an image" and "File must be less than N MB" (line 67) have none. Thumbnail built with innerHTML also carries shadow-xs (SHADOW-01).

components.name: pod-people (extends sortable package)
components.note: Drag a person between pod lists and PATCH; no visual or error feedback in JS. Drag-and-drop has no rule.

components.name: position-picker (extends checkbox-select-all)
components.note: Select all / none / by paycode with "N of M selected" count; bulk selection has no rule.

components.name: read-more
components.note: DISC-01 names read-more for long text; it swaps short/full, sets aria-expanded on the toggle, rewrites the label and rotates the icon.

components.name: register-intent
components.note: Reveals the "wrong place" message and disables submit when the trigger reason is picked; client-side guidance before submit is not addressed.

components.name: review-pane
components.note: Moves aria-current to the shown line, parks the pane under the line below lg, keeps the line in view, marks on before-frame-render and moves on turbo:load, as LAYOUT-04 and its traps describe.

components.name: scroll-to-element
components.note: Reveals an element by id or selector on connect and turbo:morph via scrolling.reveal (reduced-motion aware); the guide mentions it only to say the review pane does not use it.

components.name: scroll-to-top
components.note: Scrolls the nearest scroller to the top on connect for results pages rendered by a form submission; not documented.

components.name: search-bar (extends dialog)
components.note: Cmd/Ctrl+K search dialog: focuses input, retries failed search, own failure callouts, mode saved in localStorage, reopens after a mode visit. Global search dialog not documented.

components.name: search-matches
components.note: "Match N of M", one stop per card holding a mark, wraps past either end, moves data-landing (the ring) and reveals with behavior auto: as the Match Stepper section says.

components.name: session-watch
components.note: Visits "/" when the sign-in ends elsewhere, clearing Turbo cache and suppressing leave guards; no UI of its own.

components.name: sidebar
components.note: closeDrawer unticks #sidebar-drawer, the documented action on the drawer's Close button (2083, 2304).

components.name: sortable (package re-export)
components.note: Re-exports @stimulus-components/sortable for drag-to-reorder; drag-and-drop has no rule.

components.name: stale-results
components.note: First edit after a verify hides the commit button and shows the stale explanation; not documented.

components.name: status-warning
components.note: Holds the status submit and asks through Turbo.config.forms.confirm with server-supplied dialog HTML, so the app's dialog is used; wording is the view's.

components.name: stream-nav
components.note: Sidebar links fetched as turbo-streams with history pushed through Turbo; no loading indicator, falls back to a full visit on error.

components.name: table-sort
components.note: aria-sort only on the sorted th, muted fa-sort vs caret icons (shape change), Intl.Collator numeric, blanks last, ties in server order, "Sorted by X, ascending." to status target and #live-region.

components.name: tabs
components.note: Guide: everything works from the keyboard; tab_navigation wires the ARIA. Code: idle tabs get tabindex -1 (also tabs_helper.rb:102) but no arrow-key handler exists, so keyboard users cannot reach any tab but the active one.

components.name: theme
components.note: Saved localStorage "theme", then prefers-color-scheme, else light; sets both the .dark class and data-theme, as the Theme System section describes.

components.name: thread-live
components.note: Marks a live-arriving unread card read while the tab is visible; the server's streams update the envelope. No UI of its own.

components.name: toast
components.note: Guide: motion is the approved set only, honouring reduced motion. Code: "show" triggers a 300ms slide-in/out (toasts.css toast-base) with no reduced-motion override. Durations and roles match TOAST-01 (6000ms, error stays).

components.name: toggle
components.note: Guide: collapsible content is ui_accordion or ui_disclosure (native <details>), long text read-more. Code: a JS disclosure toggling hidden/hidden! and aria-expanded, swapping the trigger's innerHTML label ("Hide Notes"), in 7 views.

components.name: unsaved-changes
components.note: Guide: confirm in the app dialog, asking with the action. Code: window.confirm("You have unsaved changes. Leaving this page will discard them. Continue?") on turbo:before-visit; beforeunload shows the browser's own prompt.

components.name: vanilla-calendar
components.note: Guide: lg is the one structural fold. Code: width <= 768 or a mobile user agent swaps the picker for a native datetime-local input. Also builds a raw <button class="vc-close-btn"> (line 101), not ButtonHelper.
